topics.label: The War, Peace Process & Two-State Solution

parties.name: Yashar!
parties.topline:
Israel needs a government that is professional, responsible, and unifying. A government that will lead Israel as a Jewish and Democratic state in the spirit of the Declaration of Independence, with safety and security.
Gadi Eisenkott and Yashar present an alternative with professionalism and integrity.

positions.title: Draft and Service
positions.summary:
Service is mandatory for every citizen, with the explicit goal of integrating the ultra-Orthodox and Arab communities in appropriate frameworks. A special process will be made for encouraging and enforcing enlistment in the Haredi community.

The IDF gets priority on manpower, followed by civil and national service. Everyone will need to go through IDF screening.

positions.title: National Cabinet to Fight Crime
positions.summary: Create a Crime Cabinet to centralize efforts to fight crime, with a project manager under the Prime Minister and the Minister of Public Safety, with a focus on organized crime.

positions.title: Strengthen the police force
positions.summary:
Improve long term planning and funding to strengthen the police. Ensure its political independence from the government.

Develop dedicated capabilities for fighting cyber crime.

positions.title: Fight organized crime
positions.summary:
Establish a dedicated system for fighting organized crime, with special units, prosecutors, and courts. This will increase outcomes and shorten timelines, as well as build enforcement tools and expertise.

Attack protectionism through enforcement, insurance, and witness protection.

Target money laundering, control over territory by gangs, and other criminal infrastructure.

positions.title: Fight violence in the Arab sector
positions.summary: Work directly with Arab communities. Draft Arab citizens into national service focused on attacking crime in their neighbourhoods. Increase focused enforcement, and roll out new technologies to investigate crime.

positions.title: Fight violence against women and families
positions.summary: Make a plan to prevent and treat violence against women and families. Address the root of gender and family violence through education and social organizations. Attack youth violence through intervention and budgets for at risk youth.

positions.title: Local defense
positions.summary: Rebuild the local defense system, with lessons learned from October 7th. Make a team to classify localities and allocate resources to each area based on what they need to defend themselves. Define and provide training, funding, and structures to local defense teams.

positions.title: Fight corruption
positions.summary: Establish a ministerial committee to fight corruption in the government, which is full of loopholes and allows for criminals to work with politicians.

positions.title: Focus on soldiers, national service, and the middle class
positions.summary:
Build an economic policy that focuses on those who serve, young people, and the working middle class.

Tax benefits will go to those who work over those who don't, and will be based on socioeconomic circumstances rather than religious sector or life choices.

positions.title: Rebuild the State for the Jewish People
positions.summary:
Rebuild the state as a Jewish, Democratic, progressive, and just state, in the spirit of the Declaration of Independence. Work to heal the rifts of war and sectarianism.

Work to ensure a Jewish demographic majority for generations, and promote an inclusive and respectful Judaism.

Respect majority decisions, minority rights, human rights, and an independent Judiciary.

positions.title: Establish a State Commission of Inquiry
positions.summary:
Establish a State Commission of Inquiry to investigate October 7th, the decade before it, and the conduct of the war.

Focus on:

  • Policy and descision making

  • Preparation and readiness

  • How the government and army actually functioned on October 7th

  • Descision making and conduct of the political and military leadership during the war

  • Information and communications

  • Were previous reccommendations actually implemented

positions.title: Media
positions.summary: Ensure free, independent media.

positions.title: Rehabilitate and invest in the Periphery
positions.summary:
Rehabilitate and strengthen periphery areas impacted by the war.

Strengthen settlement of rural areas, and protect settlements along the periphery. Support the development of schools, youth movements, and the economy. Subsidize urban renewal in the periphery, and ensure earthquake protections.

Provide business rehabilitation grants and reduce property taxes to businesses suffering damage. Provide state guaranteed loans. Reduce corporate tax to 2.5% for businesses on the confrontation line, and 5% for general North businesses on the Kiryat Kinneret line.

positions.title: Strengthen the IDF and change the security philosophy
positions.summary: Current security strategies will be replaced with a systematic national strategy, based on planning and preemptive action. The IDF will be strengthened, the borders will be hardened, and Israel will be turned into a regional power.

positions.title: Expand peace agreements
positions.summary: Expand the circle of peace

positions.title: Energize the economy
positions.summary: Integrate all sectors into the economy. Boost growth.

positions.title: Lower the cost of living - competition
positions.summary:
Dismantle monopolies, strengthen competition, align Israel to international standards to make imports easier. Reduce bureaucracies on manufacturers and barriers on importers.

Strengthen farmers' and consumers' bargaining power. Encourage direct to consumer sales to drop costs.

positions.title: State Benefits for those who contribute
positions.summary:
State benefits (housing benefits, tax credits, ect) will be prioritized for those who serve in the army and for those who work and contribute to the economy.

Housing benefits, tax credits, civil service salaries, scholarships, arnona discounts, grants, Bituach Leumi status, bus pass discounts, after-school funding, ect, will be tiered: 1. Combat veterans, 2. General veterans, 3. National Service alumni

positions.title: Kiryat Shmona
positions.summary:
Define Kiryat Shmona as the capital of the Easter Galilee. Incentivize urban renewal and the construction of thousands of new housing units, upgrading common space, and expanding infrastrucutre.

Make a series of hubs for leadership in medical, educational, and cultural fields.

positions.title: Improve the public service
positions.summary: End political appointments and ensure appointments are made through a professional lens.

positions.title: Constitutional Reform
positions.summary:
Enact Basic Law: Legislation to strengthen the sovereignty, authority, independence of the Knesset.

Term limits for Prime Ministers - 2 terms.

Get rid of useless government ministries.

positions.title: Local government
positions.summary: Expand the independence of local governments to made descisions that match their communities.

positions.title: Stop the brain drain and encourage Aliyah
positions.summary:
Make a strategy to stop Israelis from fleeing the country.

Improve systems of Aliyah and absorbtion with the goal of having 1 million new olim by 2037 and another million by 2048.

Renew the connection between Israel and the Diaspora.

Make a body to plan the human capital needs of the country, and make sure we have the proper education, training, and immigration programs to meet the economic needs of the future. Develop a visa for talented professionals in research and business to come to Israel. Make a digital nomad visa.

positions.title: Make a planning authority for getting to Israel's Centennial
positions.summary: Make a planning authority to lead the vision and long term plans for all parts of life, and get to 2048 with a prosporous and unified country.

positions.title: Reduce the burden on Reservists
positions.summary:
During times that are neither major war nor peacetime, reserve duties will be capped at 50 days/year, with a hard limit of 150 days in 3 years.

Reservists will be given, under normal circumstances, at least 5 months advanced notice of service times.

positions.title: Benefits for reservists
positions.summary:
Every servicemember will be paid their entitlements automatically, without needing to apply or jump through bureaucratic loops.

The government will invest 20 billion shekels into reservists over 3 years, for the reservists, their families, and their businesses.

During reserve service, soldiers will recieve benefits worth, on average, hundereds of thousands of shekels:
  • Direct benefits

  • Compensation for employers

  • Advanced degree funding

  • Family funding: childcare, babysitting, after school classes, travel.

  • Housing benefits

positions.title: Increased salaries for soldiers
positions.summary: Raise all soldiers salaries by 15%, and combat soldiers salaries by 50% after 3 years of service.

positions.title: Draft Deferment and Exceptions
positions.summary:
A one year deferment of service will be available to a limited pool of individuals who exhibit extraordinary talents in the sports, sciences, arts, and humanities.

Deferment for persuing Torah studies will be available to a maximum of 3% of a years draftees. Selection will be through external criteria and be open to all applicants.

Everyone who defers will be required to complete basic training before their deferral begins

positions.title: Draft dodging
positions.summary:
Draft dodgers will be criminally prosecuted, and will be denied civil and economic benefits:
  • Participation in state tenders

  • Scholarships

  • Housing benefits/Arnona discounts

  • Housing loans and rental assistance

  • Long term rental eligibility

  • Land allocations

  • National Insurance/Bituach Leumi

  • Public Transit discounts

  • Parental benefits

  • Skilled trade training vouchers

  • Business funding

  • Tax discounts

  • Drivers License

  • Right to leave the country

positions.title: Establish a State Education Council
positions.summary: Legislate a National Council for Education (similar to the National Security Council) comprised of academics, industry, and representatives of the 4 education streams. The council will define a 5 year educational plan and establish a core curriculum.

positions.title: Define a core curriculum
positions.summary:
The State Education Council will define a core curriculum comprising basic topics like citizenship, hebrew, STEM, democracy, Jewish-Israeli identity, ect.

A new law will enourage non-state schools, particulary Haredi systems, to integrate into the state system. Schools that don't join will have their funding reduced.

positions.title: Distribute responsibilities to local government and schools
positions.summary:
Local authorities will be given responsibilities for managing the education system, including Early Childhood Education (ECE, 0-3 years). They will adust curriculums, manage budgets, and work with local industry.

Principals will be given dedicated grants to fund custom educational initiatives for their schools, will be able to structure the schedule of their school, and will be allowed to balance education with emotional support during war times.

Principals will be put on a new salary scale, and get additional support when they're struggling.

positions.title: New employment tracks for teachers
positions.summary:
A new, optional, employment track will be developed for teachers which rewards quality and productivity instead of just seniority.

Teaching time will be reduced and replaced with personal mentoring, dialogue, and addressing social problems.

National Service volunteers will be brought in to support the system and provide students with personal attention.

positions.title: AI in Education
positions.summary:
AI tools will be integrated into administrative systems to reduce bureaucratic work, including attendance, marking, adjusting the pace of learning, and making lesson plans, with the goal of freeing up more time for teachers to work with students.

AI tools will be made for students to support individualized learning, and AI will be a subject added to the curriculum.

positions.title: Early Childhood Education
positions.summary:
ECE/childcare institutions will be required to get certified, with training and safety standards. Preschool teachers will be given grants for retraining. Certifications and education tracks will be formalized, as well as periodic skill update sessions, and all certifications will be available online for parents to check and confirm.

ECE will be consolidated to the Ministry of Education, instead of the current system where it is managed by several authorities. A salary scale will be developed for preschool teachers, and base salaries will be raised.

Subsidies will be expanded for soldiers and working families.

positions.title: Reduction of exams
positions.summary:
Bagruyot (matriculation/graduation exams) will be reduced and replaced with tests matching the international PISA indicators.

Memorization based tests will be replaced with Problem Based Learning (PBL) and portfolio work.

positions.title: Focus on life skills
positions.summary: Combine formal education with informal learning to prepare students for adulthood. Examples: Financial literacy, dealing with state bureaucracy, time management. The program would also build emotional and mental resilience, and build leadership and social responsibility.

positions.title: Higher Education
positions.summary:
Shorten degree durations. Build the infrastructure for micro-credentials. Provide social and emotional support to students.

Invest in applied research, build labratories, fund researchers, and work to bring Israeli scientists back to Israel with hundreds of new research positions.

positions.title: Develop a flexible Aliyah residency process
positions.summary: Create a hybrid residency status so that people Olim and returning Israelis can divide their time between Israel and another country, so that its easier to acclimate.

positions.title: Improve the Aliyah landing system
positions.summary:
Make a one-stop-shop to address and improve the aliyah process covering:

  • Learning hebrew

  • Getting hired in your profession.

  • Getting skills and licenses recognized

  • Enrolling in schools

  • Guidence and placement in the army or national service

  • Incentives for moving to National Priority Areas


Make it so that Olim can start these processes before they land, and start other processes like opening a bank account.

positions.title: Make Aliyah easier
positions.summary:
For communities: Encourage communities to make aliyah together with special processes and incentives.

For workers: Make uplan more flexible and accessible, to be taken alongside a full work week. Make a provisional license program for Olim to start working immediately while documents are transfered.

For late-career or retirees: Change taxation laws to make those with significant assets move more easily and without losses

positions.title: Lone Soldiers
positions.summary: Expand support for lone soldiers, and encourage their families to make Aliyah through financial incentives and an expedited aliyah process.

positions.title: Housing for Olim
positions.summary:
Change how rental assistance works for Olim. Reduce wait times for low-income elderly Olim, and improve housing.

Reduce reliance on absorption centers by making more housing available in communities.

positions.title: Make Israel accessible in other languages
positions.summary: Make sure that public institutions and utilites are accessible in multiple languages, so that Olim aren't cut out of banking, healthcare, ect. Moreover, make sure that welfare serivices and housing benefits are accessible, and healthcare, mental health care, and drug information is all available in native languages.

positions.title: Transit on Shabbat
positions.summary: Local authorities will be able to make descisions about providing public transit on shabbat

positions.title: Civil Partnerships/Unions & Conversion
positions.summary: Establish a system for civil partnerships

positions.title: Support Holocaust Survivors
positions.summary: Increase funding for Holocaust Survivors.

positions.title: Prevent loneliness and boredom among retirees
positions.summary:
Combat loneliness among senior citizens, with targeted programs run by local governments. The programs will proactively reach out to seniors at risk, and provide solutions.

Develop programs to allow senior citizens to continue working and contributing their expertise as long and they want.

Develop volunteer programs for senior citizens, and establish a track in the Prefered Work program to help seniors.

positions.title: Equal opportunities for Olim
positions.summary: Make it easier for Olim to get jobs in the government and the diplomatic corps. Expand options for Olim in the IDF, national service, and volunteer programs.

positions.title: Assisting Olim in Education
positions.summary: Build a support system for immigrant children in schools, including educational support and additional funding for oleh heavy schools. Support will include closing educational gaps and fostering a sense of belonging, as well as fighting bullying, exclusion, and violence.

positions.title: Soldiers Salaries
positions.summary: Increase salaries of all soldiers in mandatory service by 15%. Increase combat salaries by 50% in the 3rd year of service.

positions.title: Committee on Youth and Young Adults
positions.summary: Create a committee of ministers on Youth and Young Adults to promote programs that are designed to support young people.

positions.title: Financial Education
positions.summary:
Teach about finances and rights before people enter the job market, so that they can read a paycheck and understand their pension funds. Make sure that information about rights, benefits, and taxes are accessible.

Create a central portal where a young adult can see all their accounts and entitelements in one single place.

positions.title: Housing for Retirees
positions.summary: Build more assissted living solutions, and increase regulations and supervision of assisted living, nursing homes, and senior homes to make sure that retirees have a good standard of living. Will add a catagory called "supportive housing" to allow seniors to live at home and still get the support that they need.

positions.title: National Food Security
positions.summary: Develop a national plan for food security, including projecting future food needs and emergency food plans, stockpiling strategic reserves, and including the agricultural sector in emergency plans.

positions.title: Agricultural financing and support
positions.summary:
Make government funding and support more effective and transparent to increase productivity and security for the farmers. Legislate the status of the agricultural sector as an essential strategic sector. Create a mix of both grants and loans to support continuity.

Fight protection rackets which are rife in the agricultural sector, and other forms of agricultural crime.

Expand the coverage of the Agricultural Natural Disaster Insurance Fund (AKIF) for farmers so that it covers natural disasters, wars, and damage from protectionism and organized crime.

positions.title: Invest in Agricultural Research
positions.summary: Invest in agricultural technology and research, specifically into climate resilience, water resource optimization, and new crops. Fund training to bring those new techniques into real farmers' fields. Fund Agrotech centers and the Volcani Institute.

positions.title: Make long term agricultural plans
positions.summary: Plan the land and infrastructure needs of farmers, long term. Regulate rural spaces to encourage capital investments and make sure that the raw materials needed for developement of farmland is available.

positions.title: Liberalizing land use for farmers
positions.summary: Allow dual uses for farmers fields, to bring in more income for farmers. Allow solar energy production, agro-tourism, wineries, farmers markets, and other permitted activities, with a clear regulatory system and funding.

positions.title: Protect the North
positions.summary:
Define protecting the north as an emergency project. Support reinforcing all housing units, schools, and clinics within 9 km of the border. Work to accelerate the completion of protection and reinforcement for buildings within 5 km by 2028, and the rest by 2030 - 5 years earlier than planned.

Bring the protections in the north to the same levels as the western Negev, and achieve a standard of having clinics be able to operate during emergencies.

Establish a distric enforcement unit of 300 police officers headed by the Chief of Police to handle serious crime.

positions.title: National Resilience
positions.summary: Establish independent local electical grids (micro-grids) containing generation, storage and consumption to remain online during emergencies.

positions.title: Renewables and the Energy Grid
positions.summary: Use the untapped renewable energy. Establish agro-voltaic generating failities.

positions.title: Tourism in the North
positions.summary:
Expand agricultural and rural tourism, and create a plan with local authorities for expansion. Invest ₪250 million into tourism in the North over 3 years.

Encourage year round tourims by investing in festivals and events outside of peak season, provide incentives to attract business tourism and conferences, and host events for soldiers in the north.

Adapt the model being used in Eilat for financial incentives.

positions.title: Education in the North
positions.summary:
Increase funding by ₪7,000/student/year in the north for pedagogical tools for 5 years, and then reduce it to the national average. Increase the informal education budget by ₪700/student/year. Transfer informal education budget to local authorities. Recruit hundreds of additional teachers, and provide salary incentives.

Subsidize Early Childhood Education ₪2,000/month if one parent served, and ₪3,000 if one is in active reserves, for families within 9km of the border.

positions.title: Encourage settlement in the North
positions.summary:
Increase the income tax benefit maximum for cities close to the border to 25%, settlements to 20%, and the north in general by 4% above where they are right now.

Work to expand the kibbutzim and moshavim, with critical professions getting benefits like long term rentals and rent-to-own, unemployment for spouses, insurance against salary decreases. Make work-from-home easier with co-working spaces and local branches of government offices.

Subsidize urban renewal in the periphery, and ensure earthquake protections.

positions.title: Healthcare in the North
positions.summary: Open a new hospital in Kiryat Shmona with specialists. Generally improve the quality of hospitals in the north, with upgrads to physical infrastructure, expansion of departments, new technologies, and emergency shelters. Bring in new doctors.

positions.title: Culture
positions.summary: Increase government funding to OECD levels. Make cultural promotion a priority for each government ministry, and give awards for achievement to great works. Invest in original TV shows, and make sure TV companies are producing high quality work. Promote Israeli culture abroad. Create a "Chief Scientist for Culture".

positions.title: Redefine roles and relationships of planning authorities
positions.summary:
Create a "National Planning Cabinet" in the government. Expand the National Planning Headquarters, put it under the Housing Cabinet, and make it responsible for coordinating the other bodies.

Define the roles and relationships between the planning and building bodies, such as the Planning Administration, Israel Land Authority, Development Authority, Urban Renewal Authority, Geographical Committee, and Housing Ministry.

Change the objectives of planning bodies to increasing home occupancy, and add provision of infrastructure and public goods to the Land Authority objective.

Work to coordinate different bodies, including synchronizing district maps, decentralization of powers, build clusters and regions, and build infrastructure to make sure that building will result in a high quality of life. Update planning committees to be run by professionals and not sectoral representatives.

positions.title: Decentralize housing planning
positions.summary: Build task forces for local authorities that have planned but unbuilt housing, to issue permits more quickly and make updates to urban plans. Shorten the approval process. Transfer planning powers to local planning committes, along with funding and support. Examine creating subcommittees for the regions that include local government representation.

positions.title: Incentivize building and make it easier
positions.summary:
Incentivize contractors with bonuses for progress and fines for delays. Bring in tens of thousands of new workers for the construction sector. Reduce regulations to bring in innovative construction techniques and technologies. Make project management easier with digital tools and AI.

Redistribute taxes from industrial areas between municipalities. Tax vacant land to encourage construction.

positions.title: Urban Renewal
positions.summary:
Prioritize urban renewal (TAMA, Pinui Binui). Make a system for adding more building permissions to plans, to make them more viable. Potentially give local committees the right to add floors to existing projects.

Change the Urban Renewal Law to focus on large scale projects. Add a focus on improving infrastructure while construction is happening, so that construction in an area all happens at once. Add protected spaces and improve quality of life in a space at the same time.

Add, as a consideration, systems to maintain the new buildings, be that a capital fund or rental spaces managed by the developer and building committees.

positions.title: Quality of life in neighbourhoods
positions.summary:
Add conditions to approving new buildings and complexes to encourage inclusion of infrastructure like transit, water and electricity, shelters, schools, employment centers, open spaces, and cultural spaces.
Plan housing around public transit and build Transit Oriented Development, so that the densest housing is near high capacity transit stations plus commercial and government centers.
Additionally, will promote environmental construction practices and preserve green spaces. Will restore areas after disasters. Will encourage development to be prepared for climate change.

positions.title: Make buying fairer
positions.summary: Make home sale prices public (in an anonymous form), so that everyone know that the going rate is for a street or neighbourhood.

positions.title: Make renting fairer
positions.summary:
Make rental contract prices public (in an anonymous form), so that everyone knows what the going rate is for a street or neighbourhood.

Change the law to make it illegal for agents hired by a landlord to get paid by the tenants, and enforce it through the Consumer Protection Authority.

Move towards a digital system for contracts, with AI and government supervision, to make sure they are fair. Provide legal supports to youth and olim for housing issues, and require towns with a lot of rentals to operate tenant assistance programs and a mediation department. Will open arbitration and fast tracked small claims processes to solve disputes quickly.

positions.title: Long term rentals
positions.summary: Encourage long term rentals, where contracts are for more than one year. Provide supports to companies that offer them. Prioritize those who completed national service for these programs.

positions.title: Rural Areas
positions.summary: Remove the planning rules that make it hard for commuities, moshavim, and kibbutzim to grow. Make specific planning rules for rural areas and preserve open spaces and regional characterisics. Allow low density construction in rural spaces.

positions.title: Pensions and Old Age Security
positions.summary:
Increase old age benefits for low income seniors. Lock benefits against inflation. Proactively find benefits and don't make the elderly apply for them.

Investigate bringing in mandatory long-term care insurance to pay for fees when needed.

positions.title: Support the families of seniors
positions.summary: Give mental health supports, training, and benefits to family members who care for senior relatives with nursing or cognitive needs.

positions.title: Healthcare for seniors
positions.summary:
Ensure high quality healthcare for senior citizens, including preventative care. Strengthen the care provided at home and in the community. Invest in preventative medicine and early diagnoses.

Increase the number of geriatric hospital beds and train more geriatric doctors. Expand care technologies to make healthcare more accessible.

Amend the prescription laws so that seniors don't need to renew perscriptions that will be with them the rest of their lives.

positions.title: Leadership in Aging
positions.summary:
Create a national plan of optimal aging to address all the needs facing seniors.

Establish a National Council for Senior Citizens to develop policies annd bring together experts.

positions.title: Preventing elder abuse and fraud
positions.summary: Strengthen oversight of people with power of attorney, to prevent financial exploitation. Establish a care system for seniors who report abuse by family members, so they don't stay quiet out of fear of losing care. Increase the penalties on financial crimes targeting seniors, and fund enforcement. Allow credit card transactions to be delayed when fraud is suspected, so its easier to get money back.

positions.title: Dignity and accessibility in aging
positions.summary:
Require the Home Front Command and local authorities to develop plans to evacuate seniors in emergency situations, while continuing access to care.

Make sure that voting locations are close and accessible, that essential services like banks and health funds are accessible, and that the government is easy to access through a single portal and senior citizen programming units.

positions.title: Transit discounts
positions.summary: The public transit fare system will be changed to give discounts to the highest users and those who served the country, rather than low income areas drawn for political reasons.

positions.title: Kashrut reform
positions.summary: Reform kashrut certification and imports.

positions.title: Mental Health and Resilience
positions.summary:
Develop a national program for mental health and resilience, to address psychological stresses. This will cover everyone from students to soldiers to workers.

Ensure ongoing support for veterans to prevent PTSD and alleviate the symptoms. Slowly move from treatment to prevention.

Ensure every citizen gets a personalized response and treatment when they are dealing with issues. Patients will get increased choice on their treatment paths, and professionals will be trained to more therapies. Communities and local government will be brought in to make sure that care is accessible and supportive.

positions.title: Cut taxes, and tax negatives
positions.summary: Reduce income taxes. To pay for it, increase taxes on products with negative societal effects, like single use plastics and sugary drinks.

positions.title: Regional rehabilitation directorates
positions.summary: Open rehabilitation directorates that are responsible for the North, South, and Central Israel, that will be one-stop-shops for support, accessing rights, and dealing the the system. The North and South will be defined as areas with high levels of trauma, and will have a systematic response.

positions.title: Improve rehabilitation services for impacted citizens
positions.summary:
Develop and implement a system for caring for and rehabilitating bereaved families, former hostages, and victims of PTSD. Every veteran will be entitled to continuing care.

Bereaved family and close friends will also be eligable for care.

positions.title: Appoint a Minister for Rehabilitation
positions.summary:
Appoint a minister for rehabilitation to be responsible for the system, remove barriers, and streamline the process.

Monitor the impacts of the rehabilitation system to see if it is successful at getting people back to work and families, and learn best practices.

positions.title: Rail Networks
positions.summary: Accelerate the completion of a high speed rail network that connects the center to the periphery. Build more metros and light rails in metro areas.

positions.title: Restore confidence to investors and businesses
positions.summary: Legislate the independence of the judiciary and protections for intellectual property, and provide confidence to businesses. Build local data centers and digital infrastructure to provide resources to startups. Develop an AI digitization of public service.

parties.name: BeYahad
parties.topline:
Implement a New Agreement that fully changes the book on how the government is run, and how it works for the benefit of Israel's citizens and Israel's standing.
To build a functioning government that works for its citizens, we need to completely overhaul it.

positions.title: Bringing the Beduins into Israeli society
positions.summary:
Build the connection between the Bedouin community and the state, with economic stimulus, education, and sanctions.

Introduce state education and enlistment in the IDF.

positions.title: Israel & World Jewry
positions.summary: Recognize that Israel's political position directly impacts the diaspora. Give the Diaspora a voice in the Knesset though a representatve of a new Diaspora Jewry Council.

positions.title: Meeting the IDF Manpower Needs
positions.summary: Recruit 20,000 additional combat soldiers.

positions.title: Fighting the cost of living
positions.summary:
Lower the cost of food by 30% within a year, by dismantling closed industries and opening Israel to foreign suppliers.

Adopt European food standards. Unite all food import bureaucracy under one authority. Prohibit monopolies from managing more than one food sector.

Prohibit contracts between suppliers and grocery stores/chains that made it harder for small importers to break into the market.

Abolish tariffs and instead subsidize farmers who are identified as being critical to Israel's food security, and invest in agriculture to make it more competitive. End production limits.

Break the Rabbinate monopoly on Kashrut through automatic recognition of foreign, recognized certifications.

positions.title: Improving the education system
positions.summary:
Improve quality of public education to meet the level of private schools

Improve teacher salaries (bring the minimum to 12,000 NIS) and reward outstanding teachers.

Extending the school day until 4:00 PM, and increasing classes, athletics, and provide a hot meal. Every child will get a voucher for extracurricular activities.

Target closing the educational outcomes gap with the OECD average within 5 years.

positions.title: Improving the Education System's Governance
positions.summary:
Completely revamp the Ministry of Education. Dismantle bureaucracy and transfer powers (70% of descisions) to local governments and principals. The Ministry of Education will become a regulator, not an operator.

Set up a National Education Council to oversee all 4 streams and create a stable 5-year plan.

positions.title: Combatting incitement, managing behaviour
positions.summary:
Monitor the education system to make sure that incitement against the state isn't being taught.

Restore discipline to classrooms: Give teachers the backing to enforce a policy of zero-torelance for violence and provide emotional support to students in distress.

Make schools safe for LGBT students and for students from LGBT families, promoting loerance and actively fighting homophobia.

positions.title: Consitutional Reform
positions.summary:
Create a Constitution in line with the principles of the Declaration of Independence
Term limits for Prime Ministers: Limited to 8 consecutive years

positions.title: Improve the public service
positions.summary: Improve the quality of the public service, through the use of KPIs.

positions.title: Fight corruption though wasteful political spending
positions.summary: Coalition Funds (government funding for niche party priorities that is promised to get parties to join a coalition) will be cancelled. Useless government ministries will be closed. Estimated savings: 4.4 billion NIS Move away from political appointments to professional appointments.

positions.title: Judicial Reform
positions.summary: Limiting and formalizing the courts' abilities of Judicial Review and striking basic laws, subject to broad consensus.

positions.title: Creating a core curriculum
positions.summary:
The state will only fund schools in the state education stream, which will be obligated to teach 100% of the core curriculum, making up a minimum of 60% of education hours. 20% will be decided by the school board, and 20% by the identity based stream.

Budgets will be focused on student needs, not classroom teaching hours, and will take into account socio-economics so every student succeeds.

Mandatory focus on values and leadership for Grade 12 students.

positions.title: Draft Equality
positions.summary:
National Service Law (ie military service) will apply to all Israeli citizens, regardless of ethnicity, religious community, or gender. Laws that permit draft evasion will be repealed.
Draft dodgers or draft evaders will have benefits removed, specifically:
- Kindergarten subsidies
- Property tax discounts
- Bituach Leumi discounts and student status
- Child support benefits
Estimated savings: 4.4 billion NIS

positions.title: Benefits only to those who embrace Israeli society
positions.summary: Benefits and government funding will only go to citizens and communities that work, enlist, and participate in the state education system.

positions.title: Improve rehabilitation services for injured and disabled veterans
positions.summary:
Create a National Rehabilitation Directorate under the Prime Minister's Office, to complement the activities of the Rehabilitation Division of the Ministry of Defense by creating a coordinating body for the relevant offices in Finance, Health, Housing, and Justice.

Provide lawyers at the expense of the state to every injured veteran, from the first meeting. Unblock bureaucracy around rehabilitation, including making all requests and forms digital and streamlined.

Remove roadblocks from injured veterans returning to the workforce without losing support and rights. Give local authorities and communities funding and tools to support disabled veterans.

positions.title: Improving mental health access and capacity
positions.summary:
Expand access to mental health supports, by increasing the number of students in mental health fields and incentivising joining the public health services. Also create tools for self care and self support.

Lowering prices for mental health care for youth. Strengthen resilience centers and mental health first aid centers.

Tailor mental health supports to critical communities, including the LGBTQ community

positions.title: Invest in Higher Education
positions.summary: Strengthen Academia to deliver economic growth. Make AI infrastructure accessible to industry and researchers.

positions.title: Housing for veterans
positions.summary: Expand the subsidized rental program by 250,000 units, and build a new city in the Merkaz specifically for young veterans. Create a new supportive housing path for wounded and disabled service veterans

positions.title: Improving access to housing
positions.summary: Allow residents in the subsidized rental program to buy their apartment at cost, minus rent paid, after 10 years.

positions.title: Foreign Hechshers
positions.summary: Regcognize foreign hechshers without needing additional approval by the Rabbinate

positions.title: Improving Israel's position internationally
positions.summary:
Actively combat international anti-Israel sentiment and work to create a positive brand. Improve regional relationships and end international political isolation. Establish a national public diplomacy body under the prime ministers office.
Build regional alliances. Normalize with Saudi Arabia, Indonesia, and other potential allies.

positions.title: Move authorities to local governments
positions.summary: Decentralize powers and give more authority to local regional governments

positions.title: Commission of Inquiry
positions.summary: Open a non-partisan, apolitical State Commission of Inquiry into the events of October 7th and the conduct of the state afterwards.

positions.title: Connecting the North with the rest of Israel
positions.summary:
Improve transit services, healthcare services, and transit access in Kiryat Shemona:
- Build a protected emergency room
- Build public transit access
- Provide subsidized flights at 99 shekels to Tel Aviv Ben Gurion


Overall increase the quality of infrastructure, housing, transit, tourism, education, ect in the north near the borders.

positions.title: Encouraging living in the North
positions.summary:
Encourage return and new settlement though economic benefits:

  • No income tax up to 1 million shekels (for 4 years)

  • Housing loan of 400,00 shekels for academics and professionals after 7 years of residence.

  • Arnona discounts

positions.title: Encouraging business in the North
positions.summary:
Create a temporary (4 years) tax exempt zone in the North near Kiryat Shemonah:
- No corporate tax for new local industries, tech companies, and defense companies. Reductions for companies near the borders.
- 50% discount on property taxes for businesses
- Grants for expansion
- Subsidize high salaries

positions.title: Building the Periphery
positions.summary:
Increase settlement of the Negev and the North with a goal of 1 million new residents in 10 years, and clamp down on illegal construction.
Build high quality hospitals in periphery.
Crack down on smuggling and drone infiltration.

positions.title: Building the North
positions.summary:
Define Metula, Shlomi, and Kiryat Shemoneh as a National Reconstruction Area, with the goal of doubling the population (relative to before the war) within 10 years.

Enact a "Frontline Communities" Law that formalizes the plan for a decade. Make benefits and incentives scale with how close a community is to the border and how much damage it has recieved.

positions.title: Fighting crime in the Negev
positions.summary:
Recognize that the Negev is in a state of emergency, and bring the Shin Bet to fight crime.

Focus on rooting out organized crime. Identify the top 3 families and top 100 criminals and go after them directly.

Double the amount of police stations in the southern district. Add mandatory minimums to sentencing.

positions.title: Civil Unions
positions.summary:
Break the Rabbanut monopoly on marriage, and facilitate civil unions through registration with the Interior Ministry. This will allow all the rights of a married couple to any couple, including same sex or different religion couples.

Adoption, surrogacy, and child registration will be made easier. Partners of a biological parent will be able to be immediately registered as a parent.

positions.title: Public Transit on Shabbat
positions.summary: Allow public transit on shabbat, based on the decision by the local regional authority.

positions.title: Improve Private and Public Transit
positions.summary:
Invest into public transit, increase the amount of high speed rail, and improve bus reliability. Create a national plan to reduce congestion.

Enact a Metropolitan Transportation Authorities Law with the goal of making public transit more efficient.

positions.title: Get local authorities involved in transit
positions.summary: Move responsibilities and authorities around transit to local regional authorities

positions.title: Improve Miluimnik Benefits
positions.summary:
Active Miluimnikim will get:

  • 1 million shekels towards their first home

  • Priority on land tenders, with the target of every reservist getting a tender within 4 years of applying

  • Highly subsizided daycare, free after-school programs, free summer school

  • 50% discount on all state service fees, including utilities, taxes, and car tests


*Defined as reservists who served 20 days in reserves over 3 years, or 15 days in combat rolls

positions.title: Improve Veterans Benefits
positions.summary:
Veterans (including those who did National Service/Sheirut Leumi) will get:

  • Priority in the housing lottery

  • Fully funded bachelor's degree (combat veterans will also get a Masters degree)

  • Free bus/train pass for 3 years (combat veterans will get for 5 years)

  • Fully funded after-school and summer schools

  • Daycare funding of 1000 NIS/month

positions.title: Fighting polygamy
positions.summary: Enforce bans on polygamy, including closing loopholes with the PA, and ensuring that Bituach Leumi isn't providing illegal benefits

positions.title: Supporting the elderly
positions.summary: Increase old age pensions by indexing them to the average salary. Doubling the pensions of retirees making below minimum wage, and gradually increasing pensions for incomes below 10,000.

positions.title: Support caregivers
positions.summary: Recognize family caregivers and provide training and support. Improve the conditions of nursing care providers. Bring in foreign workers to reach 100% staffing levels.

positions.title: Give Students an AI Teacher
positions.summary: Create a AI system to act as an individualized private tutor for students, to allow teachers to focus on coaching and providing emotional and social support.

positions.title: Connect schools with science
positions.summary: Establish 15 new STEM centers and create a link between schools, academia, and industry. Give students real world problems and embrace project based learning (PBL).

positions.title: Keep schools open in emergencies
positions.summary: The Education system will open first in any emergency. If a mall or resteraunt can be open, so can the schools.

positions.title: Supporting the Homefront - Reservists families
positions.summary:
Support the spouses, parents, and families of serving reservists. Spouses and parents will get an official designation and rights, and will be able to apply for benefits under their own ID.

More funding for families that serve more. Incentives for companies to employ spouses of reservists.

positions.title: Recognize foreign qualifications
positions.summary:
Make it easier to have foreign quailications, work experience, and internships/stague get recognized in Israel. Shorten the foreign credential recognition process, and expand the automatic recognitions from other countries.

Create targeted suplementary education processes to bring a foreign profession into the Israeli system. Combine professional instruction in hebrew with training and job placement. Connect Olim with in-demand industries.

Make opening a business easier for Olim.

positions.title: Conversions
positions.summary:
Move authority for overseeing conversions to community rabbis, rather than the central rabbanut. The process will be state-Orthodox.

Special tracks will be made for soldiers and for Olim.

positions.title: Make a centralized portal for Aliyah and Integration
positions.summary: Make a central office and portal for submitting forms and getting rights, with the principle of "just submit it once". Make information and services be available in multiple languages. Allow processes to start before landing in the country.

positions.title: Make it easier for young Olim to get started
positions.summary: Allow Olim into the national housing program, including Mechir LeMishtaken and the discounted long term rental programs.

positions.title: Add supports to the education system for students and parents
positions.summary: Make information about the education system more accessible for parents. Improve hebrew instruction and social supports for children of Olim. Combat discrimination

positions.title: Invest in culture for immigrants
positions.summary: Allocate 10 million shekels to cultural initiatives for Olim (arts, theater, ect). Strengthen projects that help Olim connect with Israeli society, like sports and volunteering

positions.title: Support Lone Soldiers
positions.summary: Make accessing benefits easier. Provide more supports to integration, for education and joining the workforce. Advance stipends to lone soldiers who need it.

positions.title: Fund community for the elderly
positions.summary:
Promote recreation and volunteer opportunities for seniors, and fund community centers. Implement a national plan to combat loneliness. Build a National Service program for retirees.

Make employment accessible.

Make specific funding for programs for Holocaust survivors

positions.title: Actively encourage skilled professionals to come to Israel
positions.summary: Make a national initiative to bring skilled professionals from abroad - both Olim and returning Israelis. Target doctors, researchers, engineers, high tech workers, and entrepreneurs, and support their aliyah and integration.

positions.title: Build community healthcare centers
positions.summary: Reduce the burden and stress on hospitals by building community healthcare centers/urgent care clinics around the country. These centers will provide simple surgeries, imaging and diagnostics, consulting, and emergency medicine. Priority will be on areas without coverage, like the periphery.

positions.title: More doctors and nurses
positions.summary:
Make a body to plan the healthcare workforce, to make sure there are enough doctors for the upcoming needs. This body will regulate training, set standards, and allocate staff where needed.

Bring medical professionals from abroad.

positions.title: Invest in preventative medicine
positions.summary: Double the investment in preventative medicine and incentivize the health funds to keep people healthy. Make a plan for healthy aging to keep senior citizens active and delay functional decline.

positions.title: Establish a national medical information platform
positions.summary: Create a national integrated platform and database for medical information, ensuring proper privacy protections, similar to Singapore. Incentivise health funds to implement new technologies, and make the approval process quick and streamlined.

positions.title: Pass a Climate Law & National Risk Management
positions.summary: Regulate and ensure that governements and local authorities are prepared to deal with climate change and extreme weather, including fires, droughts, floods, and sea level rise. A national climate risk management system will be created. Targets for expanding renewable energy, reducing car travel, and promoting efficiency will be legislated.

positions.title: Dead Sea
positions.summary:
Mineral extraction contracts at the Dead Sea will be changed with the renegotiation, so that the footprint is smaller and the company has to fix old environmental damage. Fees for pumping water will be imposed.

Long term solutions to stop the Dead Sea from dropping will be sought.

positions.title: Garbage and Recycling
positions.summary:
Targets for recycling will be raised, and landfills will be seen as a limited last case resort. Sorting and recycling will be funded. A regulator for the waste industry will be established.

Burning garbage in Judea and Samaria will be stopped, by working with COGAT and the Palestinian Authority.

positions.title: Polluting power plants and factories
positions.summary:
Close old coal fired power plants that don't have scubbers, and transition to cleaner sources.

Move the petrochemical industry away from Haifa Bay.

positions.title: Protect Eilat
positions.summary: Reimplement the "zero added risk" policy for Eilat and the Gulf of Aqaba, protecting the environment, tourism, and the sea.

positions.title: Protect Nature
positions.summary:
Preserve open space and ecological continuity, and make national ecological corridores. Focus new housing on existing cities through urban renewal, and reduce sprawl.

Fund restoration of streams, prevent oil spills at sea, preserve biodiversity.

positions.title: Make Long Term Leases a real alternative to ownership
positions.summary:
• Build 100,000 new long term rental apartments within 10 years, for young families and reservists

  • Of that 100,000, 40% will be subsidized at 30% below market rate.

  • Tax benefits for landlords who offer long term (at least 5 year) leases

positions.title: Build more housing
positions.summary:
• Cut the time for urban renewal (Pinui Binui) from 10 years to 5

  • Transfer planning powers to local governments, to make them faster.

  • Expand the number of cinstruction workers brought in from abroad, with flexible quotas and 7 year visas

  • Increase the number of civil engineers by expanding engineering programs at colleges.

positions.title: Equality for Women
positions.summary:
Repeal laws that make it easy to discriminate against women, including the expansion of Beit Dins and gender degregation in academia.

Mandate 50% female represenetation in descision making roles in the government.

Promote equal pay though regulations and incentives.

positions.title: Get Refusal
positions.summary: Legislate effective tools to combat Get Refusal.

positions.title: Equality for the LGBT Community
positions.summary:
Enact Basic Law: Equality.

Enact Sagi Laws for Equality, a pack of laws in memory of a Sagi Golan who fell on Oct 7th:

  • Marriage equality with Civil Partnership

  • Allowing parental registry for any spouse of a biological parent.

  • Add gender identity and sexual orientation to protected characteristics under discrimination laws

  • Prohibit discrimination in housing (rentals and sales)

  • Ban conversion therapy

  • Recognize and compensate victims of hate crimes

  • Make incitement against LQBTQ communities a criminal offense

  • Allocate budget to LGBT community institutions though law. Expand support for those who have been displaced form their homes, and provide transitional housing, shelter, and mental health support.

  • Regulate the use of sperm of murdered men, and allow male partners to be able to manage the process and be recognized as the father of the child.

positions.title: Support people with disabilities - make Israel accessible
positions.summary:
Create employement targets in the civil service. Fund training and adaptive technologies. Change benefit rules so that you don't lose them when you go back to work.

Open real draft opportunities in the IDF based on abilities and skills.

Incentivize builders to make at least 5% of new apartments accessible.

positions.title: Make tourism accessible
positions.summary:
Make tourist sites and transportation accessible for those with disabilities. Establish a standard for accessible hotel rooms.

Make it easy to fly, even with a mobility aid.

positions.title: Attract investment through stability and infrastructure
positions.summary:
Make the government more stable and the regulatory environment more predictable, so that companies and investors don't want to leave.

Attract large companies by offering access to national infrastructure and incentivize companies to stay and build operations here.

positions.title: Invest in AI infrastructure
positions.summary: Build the national infrastructure needed for computing and AI, and make sure that critical technologies are inside our borders.

positions.title: Easy to register a startup, easier to submit business forms
positions.summary: Make a special track for opening a startup within 24 hours. Reduce the amount of forms and paperwork small businesses need to submit, and make submitting easier. Remove barriers to expansion and make it easier to grow.

positions.title: Add protections for the self-employed
positions.summary: Provide funding to small business owners and the self employed during wars and crises to keep them afloat. Provide a mechanism for sick days and bereavement leave for the self employed.

positions.title: Early childhood education: System
positions.summary:
Raise salaries of daycare staff and fill vacant positions, to stop daycares from closing. Establish a system of state-supervised daycares, that people can opt-in to.

Oversight will strengthen, with childcare requiring certifications and training, with real knowledge of ECE.

positions.title: Early childhood education: Families
positions.summary:
Miluimnikim will have fully subsidized childacre, and vetrans will have partial subsidies.

Further supports will be given to working families, to help the parents get back into the workforce and advance their careers.

positions.title: Supports for Holocaust Survivors
positions.summary:
Increase the annual grant for holocaust survivors from 7700 shekels to 12000 shekels. Raise the monthly allowance by 10% per year instead of just inflation. Expand utility and Arnona discounts. Ear-mark any surpluses in direct government funding to alternative programs.

Make services available in Russian.

Give disability funding automatically up to a 49% level, without needing to go to a committee. Fund transpotation to hospitals and medical treatments.

positions.title: Designate violent crime as a national priority
positions.summary: Reestablish the 'Crime Cabinet" with a national coordinator. Bring the Shin Bet to action against criminals. Confiscate illegal guns.

positions.title: Tackle protection rackets
positions.summary: Create a national compensation program for businesses that are targeted by protection rackets. Regulate security companies.

positions.title: Improve the state of the Police
positions.summary:
Strengthen police by assigning the Border police to stations, expanding patrols, and encouraging veterans to join the IPS.

Legislate police independence, and keep politics out of civil policing.

Improve compensation and reward good behaviour.

positions.title: Educate Israelis on their connection to the Diaspora
positions.summary: Connect Israeli students to world Jewry and the diaspora from grade 1 to grade 12. Expand opportunities for interaction.

positions.title: Make Israel more accessible to Diaspora youth
positions.summary:
Double the number of young Jews who visit Israel.

Make Hebrew education accessible to every Jew around the world though in-person instruction or online learning.

positions.title: Fight antisemitism and improve public diplomacy
positions.summary: Create a National Authority for Combating Antisemitism abroad, though a unified government response.

positions.title: Kotel Compromise
positions.summary: Implement the 'Ezrat Yisroel' compromise for the Kotel and open the area near the Robinson's Arch to pluralistic, egalitarian prayer.

positions.title: Fighting domestic violence and sexual assault
positions.summary:
Make fighting domestic violence and violence against women a top priority for Israel Police. Expand the definition of violence to include psychological, economic, and religious violence. Fund prevention, treatment, and rehabilitation with 250 million shekels per year.

Synchronize data with the Firearms licensing office to make sure violent men do not have access to guns.

Abolish the statute of limitations of sexual crimes against minors. Establish special courts for sexual crimes. Increase police capabilities and cut processing times. Ensure care for victims in police stations.

positions.title: End wars quickly
positions.summary: End the practice of wars that last years, and react immediately to end threats.

positions.title: Disarm Hamas
positions.summary: Don't leave the Yellow Line in the Gaza Strip until Hamas is fully disarmed

positions.title: Integrate AI into our military
positions.summary: Develop the AI tools needed to maintain military superiority, and keep Israeli control over those models.

positions.title: Destroy Iran, Declare Qatar an enemy state
positions.summary:
React to missiles from Hezbollah with strikes on Iran. Prevent Iran from getting nuclear weapons, and work to collapse the Iranian regime.

Replace Qatar and Turkey with Egypt in dealing with the Palestinians. Activate the Mossad, Shin Bet, and IDF against Qatari activities in Israel.

positions.title: Increase the amount of hotels
positions.summary: Make it easier to build 3 star and 4 star hotels that are affordable, with a focus on the periphery.

positions.title: Make tourism regions and transit
positions.summary: Divide the state into 6-8 tourism regions to make work plans, targets, build transportation plans, and make it easy to access sites

positions.title: Train new tourism workers
positions.summary: Establish centers to train chefs, hotel service reps, ect to have a professional tourism industry.

positions.title: Make it easy to book vacations
positions.summary: Make a multilingual portal to help tourists plan and book vacations. Market internationally to markets that will actually book trips and visit.

parties.name: The Democrats
parties.topline: Fight for a strong, secure, and just Israel, which is Jewish and Democratic, liberal, egalitarian, and in the spirit of the Declaration of Independence.

positions.title: Regional Peace and Normalization with Saudi Arabia
positions.summary:
Recognize that Israel is viewed as an extremist pariah in the region, and rectify it. Build a regional alliance along with the USA and moderate Arab states, to collectively combat radical groups in the area. This group would also work to weaken Iran.

This requires recognizing that we need to make progress with the Palestinians to get regional buy in, and that regional partnerships benefit Israel's security.

The Democrats will also build normalization with Saudi Arabia, and support the India-Middle East-Europe infrastructure system in Israel.

positions.title: End the Swords of Iron war on all fronts
positions.summary:
End the war in all areas - Gaza, Syria, and Lebanon, though real agreements and mechanisms that make Israel safer.

Gaza will be demilitarized, Hamas removed, and governance provided by trusted international partners with a stabilization force.

The Lebanese army will be strengthened with International forces, Hezbollah will be removed from the border (and all areas south of the Litani), and Iranian smuggling will be ended. Israeli freedom of response to any violations is non-negotiable.

A security agreement will be made with Syria to stop terrorist groups, stop smuggling to Hezbollah, and make peace on the border.

positions.title: End annexation and fight Jewish terrorism/settler violence
positions.summary:
All annexationist moves on the West Bank will be stopped. Outposts and new isolated settlements will be evacuated, lowering the strain on IDF troops.

Settler violence against Palestinians will be cracked down on with zero tolerance. A national plan will be built to address the issue, including coordination of all security agencies. Police in the Shomron and Yehudah district will be strengthened, given more political freedom to carry out investigations, intelligence, and enforcement, and make it a body that is equipped to the task. Settlements that generate violent actors will be evacuated.

The PA will be strengthened to allow it to crack down on Palestinian terrorism.

positions.title: Try to create a Palestinian Alternative
positions.summary: Promote a moderate, stable, and effective alternative government for the Palestinians. No terrorist organizations will be allowed to grow into governments.

positions.title: Establish a State Commission of Inquiry into October 7th
positions.summary: Establish a State Commission of Inquiry into the events of October 7th, and fully implement its conclusions.

positions.title: Iran
positions.summary: Every tool will be used to stop Iran from getting a nuclear bomb, and to decrease the missile threat.

positions.title: Strengthen and de-politicize the security establishment
positions.summary:
Strengthen the IDF, Police, Shin Bet, ect. Make sure they have the manpower they need.

Remove politics from the defense sector and make it professional and independent. Make sure appointments are appropriate, and descisions are made by professionals.

Insulate the Israel Police Service from political interference, in both the descision making and appointments process. Appointments will be made in a standard, professional, and transparent process. Investments will be made into fighting corruption.

The IPS will be invested in, to ensure they have the manpower, training, and professionalism to address crime and other issues in Israel. To achieve this, a multi-year plan will be built to support the police, outside of political changes.

positions.title: Increase civil rights in Basic Laws/Constitution
positions.summary:
Add human and social rights (equality, freedom of expression, freedom of protest, freedom of and from religion, healthcare, education, and housing) to the Basic Laws of Israel and give that law 'Supreme Constitutional Status' [editors note: it is unclear if this is a plan for a Constitution]

Amend the Nation State Law to reflect Israel's Jewish and Democratic nature.

positions.title: Define the Knesset's role, powers, and supremacy
positions.summary:
Enact Basic Law: Legislation to regulate the status and amendment procedure for Basic Laws, as well as regulate the court's ability for Judicial Review.

Strengthen the Knesset's ability to do its work by changing how committees and the plenum operate. Also strengthen the Ethics Committee, and improve the legislative process.

positions.title: Strengthen Ethics and Professional rules on the Government
positions.summary:
Enact binding ethical rules and standards of service on government ministers and civil service employees.

Formalize legislation around legal advice and the binding status of legal opinions.

Ensure professional appointments procedures for senior appoinments, and protect politically sensitive civil servants from political pressure.

Punish government corruption and misuse of public funds.

positions.title: Term Limits for Prime Ministers
positions.summary:
8 year term limits for Prime Ministers.

Establish systems for impeachement

Prohibit holding government office while under indictment.

positions.title: Judicial Reform
positions.summary:
Repeal legislation designed to weaken the Judicial system, specifically changes to the Judicial Selection Committee and increased powers of the religious courts.

Formalize through legislation the powers and limitations of Judicial Review.

Reform the judicial system by appointing judges, establishing more appeal courts, and streamline the judicial process.

Make dispute resolution more accessible through simple processes, community focused solutions, and improving access to the courts.

positions.title: Life Cycle Events, Kashrut, Conversion
positions.summary:
Break the Rabbinate monopoly on Kashrut. Recognize non-Rabbanut conversion and non-Orthodox conversion.

Recognize liberal streams of Judaism and subsidize them as much as Orthodoxy.

Fund non-orthodox and non-religious burial ceremonies.

positions.title: National Service for All Citizens
positions.summary:
Equalize the burden in society by mandating national service for all citizens. The IDF will have priority, followed by other agencies (police, sheirut leumi, government work, ect). Mandatory draft targets will be brought it, and recruit thousands of additional soldiers including from the Haredi and Arab communities.

One option will be National Service in the healthcare system, which will be expanded.

Individuals who avoid the draft or have outstanding non-compliance orders with the IDF will have government benefits frozen, including school program discounts, Arnona discounts, and more.

Educational institutions that encourage draft avoidance will not be funded.

positions.title: Religion in the public square
positions.summary:
Develop 'clear rules' for religious practice in public spaces, ensuring that spaces are open to all citizens and that religion and prayer services can not be used as a pretext to deny access or discriminate in public spaces.
Local authorities will have powers to regulate public spaces, under the restriction of laws that ensure that discrimination is not permitted. They will try to create a balance between freedom of expression and worship and the right to freedom from religion and accessing public spaces.


Fight the 'religiousization' of the IDF, education system, and public sphere. Stop units and divisions from excluding women in order to integrate Haredim.

positions.title: Public Transit on Shabbat
positions.summary: Public transit will run 7 a week, including on shabbat. Local authorities will be given power to adapt transit lines to appropriately accomodate neighbourhoods and communities.

positions.title: Marriage & Parenthood Rights
positions.summary:
Break the Rabbinate monopoly on marriage and divorce, and legislate full choice in religious or civil marriage. Also work on civil divorce solutions for people who have religious marriages.

Allow same-sex marriage, same-sex parental registration, and surrogacy for same-sex couples. Implement full equality in all government bodies, like the Interior Ministry and Bituach Leumi.

positions.title: Protect the LGBTQ Community
positions.summary:
Prohibit conversion therapy. Recognize, by law, victims of hate crimes. Amend the Criminal Code to include incitement against LGBTQ people and increase punishments for hate crimes based on gender identity.

Add sexual orientation and gender identity to protected characteristics under laws prohibiting discrimination.

End government support for groups that promote discriminating against the LGBTQ community.

Promote a national plan to combat homophobia.

Create up to date procedures for the Trans community in Israeli prisons.

positions.title: Fund initiatives to grow tolerance and support the LGBTQ Community
positions.summary:
Expand budgets for programs that build tolerance and support LGBTQ youth. Add contents on issues facing the community to the education system.

Expand the Division for the Advancement of the LGBT Population in the Ministry of Social Equality.

Fund shelters for youth, and develop programs for youth, seniors, the periphery, in Arab and Haredi society.

Fund culture within the LGBTQ community. Work on training and job placement for people who are discriminated against.

positions.title: Redirect funds from political communities to welfare and economy
positions.summary: Stop funding politically advantageous communities and programs in the West Bank. Instead, use that money for Israel's Social Safety Net and to grow the economy.

positions.title: Support young families and workers
positions.summary: Shorten the work week, add vacation days and sick days. Extend paid maternity leave. Provide parental leave for fathers, which can't be transfered (to give the father both time off from work and the mother time off from mothering). Make early childhood education more accessible and affordable.

positions.title: Lower the cost of living and invest in transit
positions.summary:
Dismantle monopolies and bring in competition. Add more products to the price regulation list.

Strengthen farmers' power and remove barriers and brokers so that there are fewer middle-men and both the farmer and consumer benefit. Manage trade policy to protect local producers and also reduce prices.

Lower the cost of public transit and build it out, so that by 2040 Israel is a leading country. Additionally, invest in sidewalks and bike paths, and non-car infrastructure.

positions.title: Address housing costs though urban planning, and environmental protection
positions.summary:
Build more housing, particularly near transit. Expand long term rental and public housing options.

Strengthen the independence and quality of planning institutions, environmental oversight systems, and public participation. Add more local and public representation onto planning committes.

Ensure the participation of environmental organizations on planning committees.

Encourage Urban Renewal over new towns and sprawl.

positions.title: Invest in the Periphery
positions.summary:
Focus on settling the periphery and the borders as a security decision, and actively build border communities.

Invest in the economy, education, health services, housing, culture, and transportation in the North and the South. Move money away from annexation and towards the Periphery.

Invest in hospitals in the North, increasing bed spaces. Build a new hospital in the Negev, and try to build new ones in the North. Open regional specialist medical centers and buy new MRIs and CT scanners, plus other advanced medical equipment. Create a national program to bring doctors to the North and South with housing, employment for spouces, internships, and R&D investments.

positions.title: Create a Basic Law: The Environment and Climate
positions.summary:
Protect the environment by creating a Basic Law that will guarentee the right to a healthy environment and require the State to preserve natural resources.

Re-establish the Future Generations Commission [a Knesset committee from the early 2000s that had the right to intervene in legislation that could negatively affect future generations].

Enact a Climate Law, targeting reducing emissions to 50% by 2030 and 100% by 2050.

positions.title: Transition to Clean Industries and Clean Energy
positions.summary:
Close coal power plants. Rehabilitate the Haifa Bay. End industries and factories that are sources of pollution. Increase enforcement against pollution, noise, radiation, and other things that impact public health.

Reduce energy consumption and strengthen energy resilience though a transition to a cleaner and more distributed system. Accelerate the transition to renewables, deploy solar all over the country, and invest in Israeli R&D in energy and climate.

Coordinate planning of the energy sector, and make long term plans that balance energy security with economic and environmental considerations.

positions.title: Address the garbage crisis
positions.summary:
Reform the waste system by:
  • Establishing a national waste authority

  • Encouraging and investing in recycling and waste reduction to reduce the amount of trash in landfills

  • Making producers responsible for end of life disposal, and for reducing single use packaging materials




Encourage local food production and create a natifonal food security plan, and then use that to reduce food waste.

positions.title: Protect plants and animals
positions.summary:
Work with Jordan and the PA to protect the environment and water, and restore the lower Jordan and the Dead Sea.

Fight the illegal trade for plants and animals, and amend Money Laundering and Animal Cruelty laws to address them.

Make 30% of Israeli land and sea into nature preserves by 2030.

Make a national action plan to preserve and restore biodiversity, with funding.

Take more State revenues from natural resource extraction.

positions.title: Even out funding for students between religious streams
positions.summary:
End the current situation where state-religious schools are being funded 26% more than state-hebrew schools and 39% more than state-arab schools.
Funding will based solely on a school's number of students and the socio-economic background.

positions.title: Establish a State Education Council
positions.summary: Establish a council similar to the State-Religious Education Council, for the secular education system.

positions.title: Fund Early Childhood Education
positions.summary: Expand subsidized daycare for ages 0-3 and raise staff salaries

positions.title: End funding for non-state Haredi school systems
positions.summary: Currently, the government funds privately owned school systems in the Haredi community, that do not teach math, english, or civics, and promote draft dodging. That funding will be ended, and invested into the State-Haredi education system.

positions.title: Mandatory Civics Classes
positions.summary:
Add Democracy and Civics to the curriculum at the same status as Math and English.

Add study hours to all streams for Jewish-democratic-liberal identity, at a level currently used in the state-religious stream.

Fund pre-military academies and youth organizations that reflect these values.

In addition to Democracy and Civics, Arab schools will have Hebrew and English classes strengthened, and leadership invested in.

positions.title: Invest in Teachers and Principals
positions.summary:
Reform the employment structure and strengthen the role of teachers and principals. Decentralize authority to local education boards and increase professional development in staff.

Bring Arab teachers into the Hebrew education system to address the lack of teachers crisis.

positions.title: Security in the Periphery
positions.summary: Beyond removing threat actors from the borders (Hamas, Hezbollah), defense systems that cover border communities and yeshuvim will be strengthened. Subterranian protections will be implemented against tunnels. Funding will be allocated to updgade protections.

positions.title: Rejuvination of the Periphery
positions.summary:
Supports for small busninesses and bridge funding for self-employed until their businesses fully recover. Quick compensation for damage due to the war, and give residents the right to choose if they are going to remain in their homes, stay elsewhere, or move permanently.

Add 15 billion shekels to the 'Momentum for the North' plan, and create a specific law that governs the settlement of the North to streamline activities and ensure quick implementation.

Invest in social services, healthcare, education, housing, public transit.

positions.title: Local Government
positions.summary: Expand the powers of local governments, and fund them so that they can plan their regions effectively.

positions.title: Crime in the Arab Community: Task Force
positions.summary: Declare a State of Emergency and establish a cross-agency task force to tackle violence in Arab society. The task force will take the top 5% of elite officers in the Shabak, IDF, Police, and Prison Service, and will be overseen by a special "Crime Cabinet" of ministers. It will have a 1 billion shekel budget and the goal of eliminating criminal organizations.

positions.title: Crime in the Arab Community: Strengthening Policing
positions.summary:
Strengthen the police forces to be able to conduct their operations in the Arab areas, and strengthen the tools of justice.
  • Improve detective and investigative skills in Arabic

  • Improve relationships and cooperation between police and city leaders

  • Incentivize results by promoting officers who lead to a decrease in crime

  • Establish specialized courts for serious crimes

  • Pass laws that will allow for increased penalties, using biometric data to find criminals, and fight money laundering

positions.title: Crime in the Arab Community: Fighting Money Laundering
positions.summary:
Create a new Financial Crimes Unit under the taskforce in the tradition of the Zalzal Unit that used to be part of the Mossad.
