This unit will have powers to get information from banks, interface with institutions around the world (including foreign governments), and work with all financial governance organizations and regulators in Israel.

Pass a law barring 'dirty' companies from goverment contracts.

Create a governement insurance program to protect farmers and business owners who are threatened with Protection rackets

positions.title: Crime in the Arab Community: Community Work
positions.summary:
Create a new child-focused team within the taskforce to get children out of crime through education and welfare.

Make a treatment pathway for at-risk youth, with buy-in from city hall, welfare, community policing, securtiy, and education.

Add guidance counselors and youth counselors to Arab schools, with all counselors passing background checks and having professional guidance. Define a reporting path for individual children.

Change prison sentences to focus on rehabiitation, to allow people to rejoin society.

Education will be invested in to get kids into the labour market and educated on democratic values, to reject crime.

positions.title: Crime in the Arab Community: Corruption
positions.summary: Municipalities that are corrupt or taken over by criminal organizations will be run by a committee appointed by the Minister of the Interior, until they are running properly. This an already existing process called a "ועדה קרואה"

positions.title: Freedom of speech
positions.summary: Freedom of expression and protest will be protected from political interference.

positions.title: Civilian firearms
positions.summary:
Civilian firearms are viewed as a necessity for security, and must be regulated appropriately:
  • Local defense organizations will be authorized by the government on a national level, with formally granted powers, resources, and a professional operating model - in a way that implements lessons learned from Oct 7th.
    The network will be armed and also regulated.

  • Firearm licenses will be regulated more closely, to identify owners that might be dangerous to their community, and to ensure that those who are licensed are properly trained and are responsible.

positions.title: Recognize neglect in Arab communities
positions.summary: The Arab communities have been neglected, and are full of fear, crime, and violence. The state has an obligation to fight crime, bring justice, bring safety, and develop Arab areas.

positions.title: Create plans for Arab towns and communities
positions.summary:
Enact a policy of urban planning and regulation for Arab, Druze, and Bedouin settlements. New neighbourhoods and industrial areas will be planned and built, and new localities will be established.

The "Kaminitz Law" (which allows for demolition of illegal structures without a court order) will be repealed.

positions.title: Spur economic development in Arab towns
positions.summary: Recent plans will be built on, and a new 5 year plan for reducing the gaps between the Arab public and Jewish public in Israel will be implemened. There will be a focus on infrastructure, employment, and transit. Budgets will be allocated, with strong oversight systems to make sure that nothing is lost to corruption.

positions.title: Promote representation of Arab citizens in government
positions.summary: Promote the inclusion and representation of Arab citizens and communities in ministries, state owned companies, and descision making bodies.

positions.title: Invest in the healthcare system
positions.summary:
Increase contributions to the national healthcare budget, and address gaps between Israel and the OECD average.

Plan for implementing new medicines, treatments, and technologies with preemptive funding, so that it can be implemented quickly.

Increase the planning capabilities of the Healthcare funds, so that they can provide services properly to all localities and keep waiting times down. Change how the funding calculations work so that healthcare funds are incentivized to invest in the periphery.

Invest in preventative medicine.

positions.title: Healthcare technology
positions.summary:
Invest in research and new technologies, and reduce regulatory and bureaucratic burdens.

At the same time, make healthcare data more accessible and also more secure by making national rules and infrastructure for hosting health data for research, while fully protecting patient privacy.

positions.title: Healthcare in the Arab Sector
positions.summary: Strengthen health service accessibility in Arab communities.

positions.title: Mental Health
positions.summary: Establish a national headquarters for mental rehabilitation and recovery. Invest in doctors and care providers. Invest in services. Recognize professions that aren't currently recognized, like art therapists.

positions.title: More medical professionals / Medical School
positions.summary:
Increase the number of medical students to more than 2,000 per year, and at the same time increasing the standards and expectations.

Increase the number of nurses and grant specialist nurses more medical authority. Also work to create the role of physicians assistant, to reduce the load on doctors.

Work to bring Israeli doctors abroad back to Israel, and make it both easy for them to come back and also to stay (with strong professional opportunities).

positions.title: Senior Medical Care
positions.summary:
Prepare for senior citizens and retirees by strengthening community based geriatric medicine. Incentivize Health funds to prevent decline, not just to treat it after it happens. Expand rehabilitation. Allow for home visits.

Give senior citizens priority on scheduling doctors appointments. Increase the number of beds in geriatric hospitals.

Create a National Long-Term Care Insurance Law, to cover people who need long term care. Recognize caregivers and support them.

positions.title: Mental Health
positions.summary:
Create a national headquarters for managing the ongoing mental health crisis. Invest 1.5 billion shekels into mental health care. Increase the number of therapists and psychologists. Open up treatment alternatives to hospitals, including community care.

Overall, create a proactive approach to dealing with mental health concerns, particularly focusing on populations at risk such as IDF soldiers, victims of terror, bereaved families, and evacuees.

positions.title: Rehabilitation
positions.summary: Shorten waiting times and make the recognition process easier in the Ministry of Defense's Rehabilitation division, implementing the findings of the 'Mor Yosef Committee' to make the process more efficient. Services will be centralized, so that its easy to apply for and get care. The need for soldiers to hire lawyers to get proper recognition will end.

positions.title: Gender Equity in Politics
positions.summary:
Beyond committing to having 50% of the Democrats party list comprised of women (alternating, in the 'zipper' method), a Basic Law: Equity will make party lists need to have at least 40% women. Parties that don't comply will have funding removed.

40% of government companies will have to be run by appointed women.

positions.title: Violence against women and the elderly
positions.summary:
Establish an independant authority to tackle violence against women. Work to expand the definition to include economic, psychological, sexual, and digital violence.

Create a national plan to target financial fraud against the elderly and elder abuse. Increase the punishments.

positions.title: Invest in culture
positions.summary:
Increase the budget going towards Israeli culture, doubling within 2 years and targeting 1% of the government budget within a decade. Remove politics from cultural institutions.

Return Israeli culture to the international stage.

Require streaming services to invest 8% of their Israeli profits into Israeli productions.

positions.title: Repeal the attacks on media
positions.summary: Repeal the laws put in place by the current government. Cancel the closing of Galei Tzahal and Galgalatz. Protect Kan and public broadcasting by law. Secure the independence of media.

positions.title: Regulate Channel 14
positions.summary:
End excemptions that benefit Channel 14:

  • Investing in original programming

  • Editorial independence of the newsroom

  • Permission for a major shareholder to also own a radio channel (Radio Kol Chai)

positions.title: Reform the telecommunications regulators
positions.summary: Replace the two regulators - the Cable & Satellite Council and the Second Television and Radio Authority - with a single regulator that governs all technologies. This new regulator will apply a consistent set of rules to all media bodies.

positions.title: Regulate Social Media and Fight Disinformation
positions.summary:
Regulate social media with tools from the European Union, to prevent disinformation, fight bots, and protect children.

At the same time, fight online disinformation campaigns coming from enemy states.

positions.title: Benefits for soldiers and changes to the system
positions.summary:
• Fully funded bachelors degree (also for those who complete national service. Combat soldiers get more)

  • 1,000 NIS for each day of reserve duty, on top of salary replacements that they currently get.

  • More control over Miluim scheduling

  • Self employed reservists will get special benefits, loans, and grants.

positions.title: Kibbutzim
positions.summary: Create policies that benefit kibbutzim, moshavim, and small rural communities. Strengthen the economy of these communities so that they can renew their populations.

positions.title: Food supply security
positions.summary:
Make a national plan to ensure local production and emergency food stocks as part of Israel's national security. Create financial supports for farmers to ensure security needs are met and that Israeli farms can adapt to climate change.

Preserve open and agricultural spaces.

positions.title: Agricultural research
positions.summary: Strengthen R&D in the agricultural field so Israel continues to lead innovation. Introduce advanced tools to farmers. Support "agro-voltaics" (the practice of bringing solar panels onto fields in a way that benefits the crops).

positions.title: Support Senior Living
positions.summary:
Make a plan to support senior citizens living with dignity, across all government ministries.

Increase senior pensions and link the pension to the average salary, and increase it to account for not keeping up with the cost of living in the past 20 years. Work towards increased pension top-ups, and rental assistance for retirees. Add tax points for seniors who pay tax on their pensions and increase the discounts for taxes and utilities.

Make assisted living more affordable, and build new affordable apartments. Encourage elders to share houses and not live alone.

Require public bodies and private businesses to make their services more accessible to the elderly.

positions.title: Senior employment
positions.summary: Incentivize employers to hire workers over the retirement age, and create training and placements for those workers - specifically on feilds where there is a manpower shortage.

positions.title: Dignity for Holocaust Survivors
positions.summary:
A Minister-level role will be created to coordinate and champion rights for Holocaust survivors. Pensions will be increased. A special monthly pension will be given to survivors from the former USSR who mostly live below the poverty line.

Funding will be increased for nursing hours (particularly for dementia patients) and health care will be made more accessible.

positions.title: People with Special Needs
positions.summary:
Work to move people into community living, instead of institutions. Increase the pension for disabled people, and encourage joining the workforce though training, supports, and incentives.

Improve accessibility in the healthcare system for those with special needs. Make sure that public and private spaces are accessible.

Ensure that shelters and emergency response tools are available for those with accessibility needs.

positions.title: Special Education
positions.summary:
Strengthen the care and support systems from early childhood to make sure that issues and needs are identified early. Invest in training and manpower to make sure there are enough professionals in schools and enough special education classes.

Focus on inclusive and accommodating educational environments.

parties.name: Likud
parties.topline: Fight for a secure, Jewish, successful Israel, by strengthening Israeli education, economy, Jewish sovereignty and political world standing.

positions.title: Security without compromise
positions.summary: Continue a strong IDF with decisive action against enemies, and safety for every citizen everywhere in the country.

positions.title: A free economy
positions.summary: All citizens to earn a living wage through free markets, less regulation and more competition.

positions.title: Jerusalem and the Land of Israel
positions.summary: Strengthen settlement and sovereignty across Israel with Jerusalem as Israel's eternal capital.

positions.title: Education, identity and heritage
positions.summary: Create education for excellence and with a focus on Israel's love of the land, connection to Jewish heritage, Jewish pride and a democratic state.

positions.title: Society and the periphery
positions.summary: Investing in the periphery, in housing, health and infrastructure so all citizen's experience Israel's success.

positions.title: Israel in the world
positions.summary: Expand the circle of peace, create strategic alliances, and strengthening Israel as a regional and technological power.

parties.name: Joint List
parties.topline: Fight for an equal state between Israelis and Arabs, by reducing crime, strengthening Arab resources and identity and socialising the economy.

positions.title: Reduce Military Spending and End the War, Settlements and Occupation
positions.summary: Reduce military spending and redirect funds to social services. End the war, settlments, and occupation

positions.title: Expand Public Housing and Reduce Housing Costs
positions.summary: Expand public housing for all in need, cap rent at 20% of family income, reinstate the Public Housing Law, build discounted rental and purchase housing through government-owned companies, and abolish interest on first-home mortgages while lowering interest rates across the economy.

positions.title: Provide Free Education from Early Childhood to Doctorate
positions.summary: Create free education from age 0 to doctorate level.

positions.title: Raise the Minimum Wage
positions.summary: Raise minimim wage to reflect no less than 70% of the average wage in the economy.

positions.title: Enforce Labour Laws and Equalise Public Services
positions.summary: Enforce fully labour laws, minimum wage and safetly laws for all. Equalise budgets allocated to all citizens and the standards of social services, education, housing and wealfare.

positions.title: Prioritise Workers and Israeli Industry in Economic Policy
positions.summary: Believes interests of working women, working men, and industry in Israel come before the interests of multinational corporations, the United States, the International Monetary Fund, and the World Bank.

positions.title: Close Jewish-Arab Socioeconomic Gaps
positions.summary: Implement programs to close the gaps between Israeli and Arab across all elements of daily life.

positions.title: Invest in Arab Localities and Infrastructure
positions.summary: Recognise Arab localities as development areas, and large-scale government investment.

positions.title: Increase Taxation on Large Corporations and Financial Profits
positions.summary: Abolish tax benefits for financial coorporations and large companies. Increase tax on finanacial profits including stock-market profits to 30%.

positions.title: Reduce Income Tax and VAT
positions.summary: Crease an income tax exemption for employees and self-employed people earning up to the average wage in the economy, and lowering VAT to 10%.

positions.title: Expand Public Ownership and Reverse Privatisation
positions.summary: Cancel privitalisation of government-owned companies, nationalised of privatised companies and the democratisation in the management of government-owned companies. Repeal the Economic Arrangements Law.

positions.title: Restore State Funding to National Insurance
positions.summary: Return state budget funds back to the National Insurance and stop the transfer of surpluses in government to the treasury.

positions.title: Restore and Increase Social Benefits
positions.summary: Reverse cuts to benefits and raise allowance to 25% of average wage of economy.

positions.title: Reduce Crime in Arab Society
positions.summary: Reduce crime in Arab society across state instituations, local authorities, education, welfare, employment and economy.

positions.title: Strengthen Equal Rule of Law and Democratic Institutions
positions.summary: Create a state that guarantees genuine security for all its residents by the guarantee of equal rule of law, strong democratic institutions, an independent judicial system, and equal access to resources and opportunities.

positions.title: Strengthen Arab Identity and Institutions
positions.summary: Increase Arab identity in the state by strengthening institutions intended to protect them.

positions.title: Combat Organised Crime and Corruption and Ensure Civil Equality
positions.summary: Eliminate the alliance between organised crime and corruption, strengthens Arab society and local authorities, and guarantees full civil equality.

positions.title: Launch a Five-Year Development Plan for Arab Society
positions.summary: Promote a new five-year plan to develop Arab socity through quality employment, education, planning, business development, and the strengthening of public infrastructure.

positions.title: Expand Support and Protection for Crime Victims
positions.summary: Establish a comprehenzive framework for victims of crime including legal counsel, psychological support, financial compensation, and protection for families harmed by criminal organisations.

positions.title: Strengthen Law Enforcement Against Organised Crime
positions.summary: Rehabilitate law enforcement syetems, strengthen the investiations divisions, establish a dedicated State Attorney's office unit to fight organised crime, increase fund to crime prevention, increase clearance rates and ensure a professional and independent polive and State Attorney Office.

positions.title: Combat Illegal Weapons and Protection Rackets
positions.summary: Directly confront illigal weapons, protection rackets, etc which criminal organisations exert power and control.

positions.title: Close Economic and Procurement Loopholes Used by Criminal Organisations
positions.summary: The state must stop all loopholes allowing criminal organisations to amass power, money and influence, through criminals and money. Promote tight regulation of public tenders, increase supervision over contracting chains and privatisations, strengthen the gatekeepers, and wage an uncompromising fight against public and economic corruption.

positions.title: Combat Organised Crime, Governmental Corruption and Corporate Crime Together
positions.summary: Organised crime, governmental corruption and corporate crime are part of the same system, and must therefore be fought together.

positions.title: Expand Asset Confiscation and Combat Money Laundering
positions.summary: Expand significantly the use of forfeiture of property obtained through offences, deepen the fight against money laundering, and strengthen the state's capacity to locate, freeze and confiscate assets of criminal organisations and the companies linked to them.

positions.title: Protect Local Authorities, Public Officials, Witnesses and Whistleblowers
positions.summary:
Reduce the organised crime targeted at local authorities and public servants by providing them tools, budget and protection, giving them independence to support/provide for their residents.
Expand the protection system for witnesses, whistleblowers, and elected officials threatened by criminal organisations

positions.title: Improve Access to State Services and Legal Credit
positions.summary: Ensure genuine access to state institutions, public services, and law enforcement systems, stopping the developement of citizens being referred to "sulhas", forcing dependencies on criminal organisations. Strengthen the oversights on unregulated finiancial markets, expand the legal credit options for business and households and reduce grey-market loan dependencies.

positions.title: Create a “Coalition for Life” Against Organised Crime
positions.summary: Create the Coalition for Life, bringing together the state, local authorities, Arab-society leadership, civil society, and residents to coordinate the fight against crime and ensure municipalities have safe, professional alternatives to contractors linked to criminal organisations.

positions.title: Increase Community Participation and Transparency in Anti-Crime Policy
positions.summary: Involve local communities and civil society in anti-crime planning and publish clear metrics and regular updates to allow the public to monitor the plan's implementation and results.

positions.title: Reform State-Arab Society Relations and Advance Civil Equality
positions.summary: Create fundamental change in the relationship between the state and Arab society, advance full civil quality, increase trust and create equal access to resources.

parties.name: Amcha Yisrael
parties.topline: Fight for a Jewish, Zionist, sovereign state focused on security, IDF/reservist rights and transparency in government.

positions.title: Restore State Foundations and National Unity
positions.summary: Return Israel to the foundations that built the state; faith, initiative, decisiveness, responsibility, governance and unity.

positions.title: Jewish, Zionist and Sovereign State
positions.summary: Believes in a state that is Jewish, Zionist and sovereign, where Judaism invites rather than coerces. The state would express the Jewish people's right to self-determination in its homeland, alongside a shared fate among those who serve from all sectors.

positions.title: Defend Israel’s Jewish National Homeland
positions.summary: The land of Israel belongs to the Jewish people, and will wage an all-out war against any idea/vision whose purpose is the destruction of Israel.

positions.title: Deter and Weaken Israel’s Enemies
positions.summary: Establish a reality in which enemies lose both the will to fight and the ability to build up their strength, recover and threaten.

positions.title: Intensive Fighting to Release Reservists
positions.summary: Intensive fighting and rapid decisions required in order to release reservists as quickly as possible.

positions.title: Lead a Security Doctrine and Gaza Emigration Plan
positions.summary: Demand to lead the complete security doctrine including leading a voluntary emigration plan for all who wish to leave Gaza, framework in international agreements and cooperating countries willing to accept immigrants.

positions.title: Strengthen International Advocacy and Freedom of Action
positions.summary: Operate proactively and assertively in international arenas, expand political and security freedom of action through a proactive and non-apologetic communications and public-advocacy.

positions.title: Strengthen Border Regions
positions.summary: Strengthen the border regions as a national and security objective.

positions.title: Develop Priority Areas Through Investment and Incentives
positions.summary: Strengthen priority areas through a comprehensive plan promoting improved tax incentives, education, transport and governance.

positions.title: Expand Jewish Settlement in Border and Threatened Areas
positions.summary: Promote strong Jewish settlement in border regions and threatened areas.

positions.title: Decentralise and Empower Local Authorities
positions.summary: Empower local authorities by decentralising powers and provision of resources.

positions.title: Reward Security and National Contributions
positions.summary: Prioritise those who contribute to its security and national resilience including allocation of land and benefits to attract capital to the border regions and threatened areas.

positions.title: Establish Mandatory Military or National Service
positions.summary: Enact a Basic Law: All must serve. Shared responsibility by military service for those suited to it and meaningful national service for those who cannot serve. Possibility of a special track for outstanding Torah scholarship will be preserved as Torah study is a value, but shared responsibility/service is the rule not the exception.

positions.title: Differentiate Benefits According to Service
positions.summary: Create a differentiated system of rewards based on service factors so individuals will be rewarded according to contribution.

positions.title: Strengthen Enforcement Against Organised Crime and Weapons
positions.summary: Strengthen enforcement and punishment with an emphasis on protection rackets, illegal weapons and weapons smuggling.

positions.title: Establish a Nationwide Anti-Crime Enforcement Operation
positions.summary: Establish a nationwide enforcement operation/body to combat crime.

positions.title: Define Government Powers Through Judicial Accountability
positions.summary: Powers of government will be defined by a judicial system operating with transparency, measurement and accountability.

positions.title: Separate the Attorney General’s Roles
positions.summary: Advance the division of the role of the Attorney General into an independent General Prosecutor and legal counsel to the government.

positions.title: Create Additional Judicial Appeals and Checks
positions.summary: Checks and balances in the judicial system such as the right to appeal judicial decisions of the High Court of Justice through an supreme appellate court.

positions.title: Increase Transparency and Accountability of Elected Officials
positions.summary: Elected officials to commit to transparency, responsibility and accountability.

positions.title: Establish Common Core Education and Jewish-Zionist Studies
positions.summary: All children will receive quality core studies, alongside education in Jewish values, the complete story of Jewish communities, Zionism and civic responsibility, with a common basic standard across all education.

positions.title: End Funding for Anti-Zionist Education
positions.summary: No funding to Anti-Zionist education programs.

positions.title: Increase School Autonomy and Measure Educational Outcomes
positions.summary: Restore independence to school principles for internal decisions, whilst establishing measuring values and achievements.

positions.title: Decentralise Education Administration
positions.summary: Decentralise operating education powers to local authorities and establish measures in the hand of the Ministry of Education.

positions.title: Promote Free Markets and Break Up Monopolies
positions.summary: Strive for a free market and the break up of monopolies.

positions.title: Reward Work and National Service Through Tax Incentives
positions.summary: The state will reward work and service through tax benefits, incentives and rewards to those who serve.

positions.title: Renew Periphery Communities and Infrastructure
positions.summary: Renew cities and communities in the periphery with protection and infrastructure.

positions.title: Reduce Regulatory Barriers for Small and Medium Businesses
positions.summary: Remove regulatory and bureaucratic barriers that hinder small and medium-sized businesses.

positions.title: Implement Long-Term National Infrastructure Planning
positions.summary: Establish a multi-year plan for energy, water, transportation, communications and ports.

positions.title: Strengthen Strategic Technology and Infrastructure Independence
positions.summary: Due to AI, Israel must ensure control over critical systems and prevent strategic dependence on foreign infrastructure, and invest in strategically important technology to ensure Israel’s advancement and independence.

positions.title: Establish a State Diplomacy and Public Advocacy Apparatus
positions.summary: Establish a professional state run diplomacy and public-advocacy apparatus to confront antisemitism and share Israel’s story globally.

positions.title: Establish an Independent October 7 Commission of Inquiry
positions.summary: Establish an extensive, independent commission of inquiry into the October 7 massacre, which will be granted the full powers of a state commission of inquiry, along with the authority to enforce its conclusions.

positions.title: Investigate All Relevant Institutions and Officials Regarding October 7
positions.summary: Investigate the government, the Knesset, the defense establishment, intelligence officials, the judicial system and the professional systems in the inquiry of October 7. Leave no stone unturned, full power to investigate anyone or anything of relevance.

positions.title: Trace the Lead-Up to October 7 from Operation Protective Edge
positions.summary: October 7 inquiry will begin with Operation Protective Edge to understand the processes that lead to the massacre.

positions.title: Base the October 7 Inquiry on Truth, Trust and Results
positions.summary: October 7 inquiry will be based on truth, trust and results.

positions.title: Establish a Nine-Member October 7 Inquiry Commission
positions.summary: Oct 7 inquiry commission chair will be selected by majority voted MK by Knesset, with second highest as Deputy. Both will be judges. The commission will be made up of nine members: chair, deputy, three professionals, a local authority member and three family representative,

positions.title: Set Measurable Goals and Public Accountability for National Tasks
positions.summary: Oct 7 inquiry national tasks will receive measurable goals, a priority order, a timetable and one responsible minister, with a public implementation report produced yearly alongside a separate detailed work plan.

positions.title: Prevent Terrorism from Leading to a Palestinian State
positions.summary: Security through the denial that terrorism will lead to a Palestinian state being established

positions.title: Use Territorial Control as a Security Measure Against Enemies
positions.summary: Enemies who go to war with Israel lose territory. Enemy areas used for a base of attack and come under Israeli security control will not be automatically return to the enemy.

positions.title: Maintain Security Control and Prevent Hamas Reconstruction in Gaza
positions.summary: Gaza will not be allowed to return to what it is, the population must be separated from Hamas through security control and prevention of reconstruction as a deterrence.

positions.title: Maintain IDF Freedom of Action in Lebanon
positions.summary: Freedom of action in Lebanon for the IDF as long as there is any Hezbollah presence

positions.title: Neutralise Iran’s Nuclear and Missile Capabilities and Seek Regime Change
positions.summary: Rid Iran by finishing "Roaring Lion" and "With All Our Might", neutralising nuclear power, long-range missiles and increasing intensive multidimensional activity to overthrow the Islamic Republic regime.

positions.title: Disarm the Palestinian Authority
positions.summary: The Palestinian Authority must be disarmed of its weapons, except for light weapons for policing purposes, and the agreements must be implemented again to prevent an October 7 attack in Judea and Samaria.

positions.title: Maintain Security Presence and Expand Settlement in Judea and Samaria
positions.summary: Continuous security presence, full freedom of action, the elimination of terrorist infrastructure, governance and deepening settlement in Judea and Samaria

positions.title: Maintain Strategic Positions and Counter Threats in Syria and Lebanon
positions.summary: Preserve the achievements in Syria by not giving up key territories that the IDF controls, strangling Hezbollah in Lebanon, preventing hostile Turkish entrenchment, and protecting members of the Druze community from massacres by extremist Muslim militias in the country.

positions.title: Prepare for Potential Threats from Regional States
positions.summary: Ensure that the security establishment takes countries, with an emphasis on Turkey and Egypt, that pose a potential threat seriously and prepares for extreme scenarios.

positions.title: Conduct Offensive International Media and Public Advocacy
positions.summary: Treat world media and the international belief that our blood is permissible to shed as a war waged on Israel and treat it offensively.

positions.title: Maintain State Control Across Israel and Address Internal Security Threats
positions.summary: The state must control Judea and Samaria, the Negev, the Galilee, mixed cities and everywhere and view the loss of internal and territorial control as a security threat, not merely an enforcement problem.

positions.title: Increase Security Independence and Strategic Stockpiles
positions.summary: Be security independent by maximum independence in production, ammunition and the creation of strategic stockpiles and by diversifying sources of supply of what cannot be produced independently.

positions.title: Integrate Haredi Population Into Military or National Service
positions.summary: Bring Haredi population into serving wisely, through agreement and respect.

positions.title: Reduce Judicial Influence Over Security Forces
positions.summary: Reduce the influence of the judicial system on the security forces so the state can act accordingly to reality.

positions.title: Prioritise IDF Soldiers’ Lives in Military Decision-Making
positions.summary: The lives of IDF soldiers come before everything, above enemy civilians and double-standard international norms.

parties.name: Yisrael Beiteinu
parties.topline: Fight for a Zionist, security-focused and economically liberal Israel with mandatory service, strong governance, secular religious reform, and broad social welfare.

positions.title: Government Composition
positions.summary: The government will be solely composed of Zionist parties.

positions.title: October 7 Commission of Inquiry
positions.summary: Establish a State Commission of Inquiry into the October 7 Massacre to determine responsibility at the political, military and intelligence levels.

positions.title: Constitution and Constitutional Court
positions.summary: Establish a constitution based on the work of Professor Reichman, Professor Friedman and Moshe Nissim, defining and protecting the principles of democracy; establish a Constitutional Court; fortify Basic Laws; amend the Nation-State Law to define Israel as a Jewish and democratic state with equal rights for members of every religion and other nationality; oppose the French Law and Override Clause.

positions.title: Prime Minister Terms and Government Stability
positions.summary: Limit the Prime Minister to two terms and prohibit anyone under indictment from running for president or forming a government. Allow a government to be overthrown during its first two years only with a 90-MK majority, reduce the number of ministers and abolish unnecessary government ministries.

positions.title: Government Powers and Bureaucracy
positions.summary: Strengthen government powers and reduce bureaucratic control over decision-making.

positions.title: Women's Political Representation
positions.summary: Ensure appropriate representation of women on Knesset election lists, in local authorities and religious councils.

positions.title: Biennial State Budget
positions.summary: Adopt a biennial state budget to promote government, economic and market stability.

positions.title: Political Financial Transparency
positions.summary: Require public disclosure of financial declarations by the Prime Minister, ministers and heads of all political parties, and enact a Transparency and Oversight Law covering political-party activity online.

positions.title: Mandatory National and Civilian Service
positions.summary: Mandatory conscription for all citizens over 18 in two tracks: military or civilian; lower the age of exemption; create a dedicated framework for Haredim and members of minorities within service.

positions.title: Service Evasion Penalties
positions.summary: Evasion of service will lead to denial of benefits; deserters will be subject to a criminal record, prevention of leaving the country and denial of the right to vote.

positions.title: National-Civilian Service Authority
positions.summary: Transfer National-Civilian Service Law responsibility to the Home Front Command.

positions.title: Pre-Military Program Authority
positions.summary: Transfer pre-military preparatory programs responsibility to the Ministry of Defence.

positions.title: Haredi Allowances and Employment
positions.summary: Cancel government allowances to yeshiva/kollel students; promote Haredi employment through employment incentives and a lower service-exemption age.

positions.title: National Security Priority
positions.summary: Recognise national security as the top of priorities; IDF to focus on external threats.

positions.title: Border Inviolability
positions.summary: Every violation of the border into Israeli territory, even by one millimeter, will be considered an invasion; security zones to be in the enemy's territory and not in the territory of the State of Israel.

positions.title: Pre-Emptive Strike
positions.summary: The pre-emptive strike initiative must always be at hand for enemies and stop the build-up of enemy powers.

positions.title: Precision Weapons and Home Front Threats
positions.summary: Precision weapons enemies will be considered a severe harm to the home front.

positions.title: 45-Day Ammunition Stockpile
positions.summary: Create an ammunition stockpile sufficient for 45 days of fighting, maintained even in a multi-front confrontation.

positions.title: IDF Qualitative Advantage
positions.summary: Strictly maintain the qualitative advantage of the IDF over every other army in the Middle East.

positions.title: Defence Industries
positions.summary: Strengthen defence industries.

positions.title: Military Equipment and Defence Systems
positions.summary: Invest in military equipment, including a laser-based interception system, a dedicated interception system for drones and UAVs, new generation of cannons for rapidly firing precise shells, five new armoured brigades equipped with Barak tanks, “Trophy” systems and additional defence needs.

positions.title: IDF Outposts
positions.summary: Establish new IDF offensive and defensive outposts, especially on the North border.

positions.title: Defence Budget
positions.summary: Increase defence budget from 70 billion to 96 billion for ten years.

positions.title: NCO Salaries
positions.summary: Increase non-commissioned officers in military professions salaries.

positions.title: General Staff Positions
positions.summary: Reduce Major General positions in the General Staff to no more than 15 and the number of Brigadier General positions to no more than 50.

positions.title: Weapons Theft Penalties
positions.summary: Punishment for theft of weapons from the IDF will be doubled to 10 years actual imprisonment; change rules of open fire on thieves of equipment in closed military areas.

positions.title: Military and Intelligence Capabilities
positions.summary: Establish a powerful Missile Corps, new Intelligence arenas emphasising on Iraq and Yemen, new Border Police battalions and increase number of manoeuvring divisions; increase ability, resources, vehicles and tech of Air Force and Navy.

positions.title: Ground Forces Command Status
positions.summary: Head of Ground Forces Branches to be on the same level as commander of Air Force and Navy.

positions.title: Border Security Responsibility
positions.summary: Transfer border security responsibility to the police.

positions.title: Home Front Command Responsibility
positions.summary: Transfer Home Front Command responsibility to National Security.

positions.title: Emergency Economy Authority
positions.summary: Transfer responsibility for the emergency economy system from the Ministry of Defense to the Prime Minister's Office.

positions.title: Egypt, Jordan and Yemen Brigades
positions.summary: Implement new brigades for Egypt, Jordan and Yemen as full 24/7 readiness.

positions.title: Shamgar Report
positions.summary: Adopt the Shamgar Report as the exclusive basis for all future prisoner and missing-person deals.

positions.title: Gaza Responsibility
positions.summary: End Israel’s responsibility of the Gaza Strip by closing crossings and disconnecting water, electricity and fuel resources; responsibility will be transferred to an agreed international body whilst maintaining the IDF’s freedom of action in Gaza.

positions.title: Jordan Security and Economic Cooperation
positions.summary: Stabilize the security and economic situation in cooperation with Jordan.

positions.title: Zero Tolerance for Crime
positions.summary: Implement a zero-tolerance policy toward criminal and nationalist terrorism, prioritizing organized crime, agricultural crime, drugs, violence, public corruption, invasions of state lands and illegal construction.

positions.title: Organized Crime Headquarters and Courts
positions.summary: Establish a national headquarters for the fight against organized crime and protection with dedicated legislation to arrest criminal heads and use of spyware; establish three courts of crime: North, South and Lod.

positions.title: Police Strengthening Plan
positions.summary: Implement a NIS 3 billion national plan to strengthen the Israel Police, adding 3,000 officers: 1,000 to the Negev, 1,000 to the North, and 1,000 to urban stations, with emphasis on mixed cities.

positions.title: Campus Security and Nakba Law
positions.summary: Strengthen campus security; expand the “Nakba Law” to allow withholding budgets from bodies acting against state principles, and impose deterrent sanctions for incitement against the state or displaying enemy flags on campuses.

positions.title: Protection of Minors and Helpless Persons
positions.summary: Toughen penalties for harming minors and helpless persons.

positions.title: Agricultural and Nationalist Crime
positions.summary: Establish dedicated district headquarters in the Ministry of National Security to combat agricultural and nationalist crime; toughen the Penal Law and adapt it to combating agricultural crime, similar to measures established to prevent sand theft; appoint dedicated prosecutors and judges and establish courts to combat organized and agricultural crime; provide budgetary assistance to communities in combating agricultural and nationalist crime; establish agricultural farms in the Negev and Galilee to protect state lands and prevent invasions; establish a safety net or insurance fund, similar to the Kanat model, to compensate farmers and victims of protection-money collection.

positions.title: Negev and Galilee Planning Committee
positions.summary: Establish a Ministerial Committee for Planning and Construction in the Negev and Galilee to re-examine building-permit allocations in comprehensive plans.

positions.title: Security Considerations in Planning
positions.summary: Incorporate security, criminal, and national considerations into planning and building-permit decisions.

positions.title: Rural Land Pricing and Discounts
positions.summary: Adjust land prices, valuations, and discounts in rural areas to support the State of Israel’s Zionist and settlement objectives; increase valuation discounts and set a price ceiling for residential land based on military and active reserve service.

positions.title: Negev and Galilee Communities
positions.summary: Strengthen existing communities in the Negev and Galilee in line with Zionist settlement objectives, and accelerate implementation of government decisions to establish new communities.

positions.title: Regional Council Plans
positions.summary: Promote and implement long-term comprehensive plans for regional and local councils in the Negev and Galilee.

positions.title: Admissions Committees
positions.summary: Preserve the settlement character by increasing the admissions-committee quota to 1,000 households, and up to 1,500 with Ministerial Committee approval.

positions.title: Comprehensive Regional Agreements
positions.summary: Pursue comprehensive regional agreements rather than a Palestinian-only agreement, addressing relations with Arab states, the Palestinians, and Israeli Arabs together.

positions.title: Arab Diplomatic and Economic Cooperation
positions.summary: Make regional diplomatic and economic cooperation with Arab states a central component of any agreement, alongside addressing the Palestinian issue.

positions.title: Regional Alliance Against Islamist Organizations
positions.summary: Seek to build a regional alliance against radical Islamist organizations, including ISIS, Jabhat al-Nusra, the Muslim Brotherhood, Hamas, Islamic Jihad, and Hezbollah.

positions.title: Regional Package Deal
positions.summary: Pursue a comprehensive regional package deal under conditions considered reasonable and acceptable to Israel.

positions.title: Israeli Arab Loyalty
positions.summary: Require loyalty to the State of Israel from Israeli Arabs, based on the principles of the Declaration of Independence.

positions.title: Deterrent Measures Against State Opposition
positions.summary: Establish legislative tools for deterrent punishment of incitement against the state, participation in meetings with Israel’s enemies, and opposition to the fundamental principles of the Zionist state.

positions.title: Central Elections Committee
positions.summary: Prevent the recurrence of situations in which Central Elections Committee decisions to disqualify lists or candidates are overturned.

positions.title: Rights of Non-Jewish Citizens
positions.summary: Ensure full rights and respect for non-Jewish citizens who identify with and contribute to the state.

positions.title: Legal Action Against Anti-State Activity
positions.summary: Take legal action against individuals who act against the state.

positions.title: Jerusalem Status and Institutions
positions.summary: Maintain Jerusalem as the united capital of Israel and the Jewish people, with no negotiations over its status; continue government programs to strengthen Jerusalem’s security, economy, society, and tourism; transfer government and public institutions to Jerusalem.

positions.title: Freedom of Worship
positions.summary: Guarantee free access to holy sites and full freedom of worship for members of all religions.

positions.title: National Public Diplomacy System
positions.summary: Establish a professional, coordinated national public diplomacy system to centralize Israel’s public diplomacy activities in Israel and abroad.

positions.title: Economy-Wide Package Deal
positions.summary: Promote an economy-wide package deal including reducing regulations, reducing ministries and public sector, dismantling monopolies and increasing competition.

positions.title: Disposable Income
positions.summary: Increase disposable income of every citizen.

positions.title: Cost of Living
positions.summary: Lower the cost of living by encouraging the entry of international chains, increasing import competition, removing barriers, reducing regulation, and investing extensively in national infrastructure projects.

positions.title: Labour-Market Participation
positions.summary: Expand labor-market participation among all populations, including the Haredi population, Arab society, and minorities, to increase employment and economic participation.

positions.title: Employment Grant
positions.summary: Expand Employment Grant eligibility to single people over 26 earning up to NIS 8,000/month.

positions.title: Privatization
positions.summary: Continue privatization, including Ashdod Port and Haifa Airport.

positions.title: Parallel Imports
positions.summary: Regulate parallel imports and abolish the status of the exclusive importer.

positions.title: Food Market Monopolies
positions.summary: Eliminate food-market monopolies by implementing the Blinokov Committee’s recommendations on concentration.

positions.title: Production Councils
positions.summary: Dismantle production councils, including the Poultry Council and Plants Council.

positions.title: Child Allowances
positions.summary: Abolish child allowances from the fifth child onward.

positions.title: Labour Dispute Resolution
positions.summary: Require mandatory arbitration for labor disputes in essential services and mandatory mediation before legal proceedings in non-essential services.

positions.title: Government Service Ratings
positions.summary: Establish a public citizen-feedback system to rate government ministries’ service quality and publish the ratings.

positions.title: Civil-Service Pay
positions.summary: Shift civil-service compensation from seniority-based to performance/excellence-based pay.

positions.title: Civil-Service Retirement
positions.summary: Promote voluntary retirement from unnecessary positions without replacement, while transferring and retraining employees for needed civil-service roles.

positions.title: Government Recruitment
positions.summary: Shorten government recruitment procedures through binding processing-time limits, advanced recruitment methods, and completion of hiring within one month; transfer recruitment authority to individual government ministries.

positions.title: AI Investment
positions.summary: Invest NIS 1 billion over 5 years in AI, including infrastructure, computing, laboratories, startups, companies and R&D centers.

positions.title: Researchers and Doctoral Students
positions.summary: Increase researchers and doctoral students through talent-return programs, training and grants for advanced professional training.

positions.title: National Research Infrastructure
positions.summary: Invest NIS 1 billion in national research infrastructure, including supercomputers, quantum computing, physics, biotechnology and optics; require academia-industry cooperation for grants; support existing R&D centers and selected programs.

positions.title: Housing Supply
positions.summary: Increase housing supply by changing land tenders to compete on construction quality, delivery speed and final consumer price, not land price; prohibit post-tender specification changes; incentivize rapid, large-scale local-authority approvals; expand planning powers; promote industrialized construction.

positions.title: Regional Council Building Permits
positions.summary: Issue 2,500 building permits per regional council over 4 years through framework agreements.

positions.title: Long-Term Rental Housing
positions.summary: Market 20,000 long-term rental units annually, with designated land and developer grants in national-priority and other areas requiring government assistance.

positions.title: Rent-to-Own Housing
positions.summary: Establish Rent-to-Own: long-term rental followed by purchase at a predetermined price, with up to 30% of rent accumulated as equity; prioritize reservists, working families and peripheral residents.

positions.title: Service-Based Housing Eligibility
positions.summary: Require military or national service for housing-benefit eligibility.

positions.title: State-Supported Safety Net
positions.summary: Establish a state-supported safety net through voluntary monthly deposits into designated funds, matched by the state; allow use for unemployment, illness and emergencies, with unused funds transferred to pension savings at retirement.

positions.title: Core Education
positions.summary: Strengthen state education, adapted to the 21st century with mandatory core studies; require full core studies in every government-funded institution, with external supervision and annual tests; institutions that do not meet core requirements will not receive funding; abolish exempt institutions’ special status; prevent anti-Zionist content from entering Israeli education, including a civics test for teachers integrating from the Palestinian education system.

positions.title: Great Schools
positions.summary: Operate “Great Schools” throughout July and August.

positions.title: Daycare Subsidies
positions.summary: Subsidize daycare where both parents work at least 125% of a position.

positions.title: 12th-Grade Reform
positions.summary: Replace the existing 12th-grade study/exam format with a year preparing students for adult life, military/civilian service, practical skills, professional experience, leadership and volunteering.

positions.title: Teacher and Principal Reform
positions.summary: Expand principal autonomy, including personal contracts for outstanding teachers; base teacher pay on innovation, excellence and teaching quality, not seniority alone; strengthen young teachers’ status and salaries; salary additions for teachers will be transferred directly to the teachers’ accounts.

positions.title: Class Sizes and Education Budgeting
positions.summary: Reduce class sizes; expand advanced/adapted learning; strengthen teachers; equalize budgeting across education streams.

positions.title: Informal Education
positions.summary: Permanently and equally fund informal education, including youth movements, youth organizations and community frameworks.

positions.title: School Vacation Calendar
positions.summary: Align school vacations with the economic vacation calendar.

positions.title: Higher Education and R&D
positions.summary: Strengthen higher education and significantly increase R&D budgets.

positions.title: Birth-to-Six Investment
positions.summary: Increase birth-to-six investment in infrastructure, staffing, quality, availability, supervision and lower child/staff ratios; address workforce shortages through higher wages and conditions, professional training, career paths, and recruitment/retention incentives.

positions.title: Child Development Services
positions.summary: Expand emotional and developmental services; strengthen Tipat Halav and child-development services, including staffing, assessments and paramedical treatment, and reduce waiting times.

positions.title: Early Identification and Information Sharing
positions.summary: Establish national early-identification and information-sharing systems across education, health and welfare for rapid coordinated intervention.

positions.title: Centers for Children Exposed to Violence
positions.summary: Establish dedicated centers for children harmed by or exposed to violence.

positions.title: Youth Mental Health and Resilience
positions.summary: Expand emotional/social services, rehabilitation and resilience programs, especially in confrontation-line and war-affected communities; provide professional treatment and youth training in initial psychological aid.

positions.title: Youth Violence Prevention
positions.summary: Strengthen prevention and enforcement against youth violence and crime; provide safe environments, youth/employment frameworks, and tolerance and responsibility education.

positions.title: Youth Public Transportation
positions.summary: Improve youth public transportation through accessible/frequent service, metropolitan transport authorities, better peripheral service and lower travel costs.

positions.title: Driving Licence Access
positions.summary: Reduce driver’s-license costs, bureaucracy and driving-lesson barriers.

positions.title: Youth Representation
positions.summary: Legislate independent, meaningful student and youth council representation in decision-making.

positions.title: Chief Rabbinate Structure
positions.summary: Establish one Chief Rabbi of Israel and one city rabbi per local authority.

positions.title: Religious Councils
positions.summary: Abolish religious councils and establish municipal departments for religious services.

positions.title: Shabbat Local Authority Powers
positions.summary: Transfer authority over business openings and public transportation on Shabbat to local authorities; operate public transportation on Shabbat in accordance with the decision of the local authorities.

positions.title: Civil Marriage and Divorce
positions.summary: Establish civil marriage and divorce for every citizen.

positions.title: Kosher Certification and Conversion
positions.summary: Reform kosher certification and conversion through city rabbis; adopt the Nissim Report on conversion.

positions.title: Rabbinical Institutions
positions.summary: Ensure representation of women and all Jewish sectors on the Council of the Chief Rabbinate; transfer rabbinical-court responsibility to the Ministry of Justice.

positions.title: Law of Return Immigrant Status
positions.summary: Protect the status of Law of Return immigrants recognized as Jewish, including non-halachically Jewish immigrants who serve, work or pay taxes; prohibit renewed Jewishness examinations and interference with population-registry nationality through hidden markers or codes.

positions.title: Pension Reform
positions.summary: Complete pension reform with an income supplement up to the minimum wage, through two 15% increases.

positions.title: Free Public Transport for Pensioners
positions.summary: Provide free public transportation to all pensioners.

positions.title: Senior Grants
positions.summary: Increase the Holocaust survivor grant to NIS 8,000; refused-immigrant grant to NIS 10,000; and Prisoners of Zion allowance by 25% to approximately NIS 4,375.

positions.title: Lone Soldier Rent Assistance
positions.summary: Provide discharged lone soldiers with rent assistance of up to NIS 1,000/month for 12 months.

positions.title: Disability Employment
positions.summary: Establish government programs integrating people with disabilities into employment.

positions.title: Old-Age Allowance
positions.summary: Gradually raise the basic old-age allowance to 25% of the average wage, indexed to the average wage or index, whichever is higher.

positions.title: Senior Income Support
positions.summary: Gradually raise income support for low-income seniors without sufficient pensions to the minimum-wage level.

positions.title: Senior Rights and Care
positions.summary: Establish coordinated senior-rights and services systems; reform long-term-care insurance; strengthen geriatric and community care; reduce health, long-term-care and housing costs.

positions.title: Preventive Medicine for Seniors
positions.summary: Expand preventive medicine and early detection; support family caregivers.

positions.title: Senior Crime Prevention
positions.summary: Establish a national program against fraud, scams, violence and crime targeting seniors, including digital security.

positions.title: Senior Access to Services
positions.summary: Simplify access to rights; make government services fully accessible; provide digital training.

positions.title: Senior Government Institutions
positions.summary: Establish government-level senior policy responsibility, a dedicated Knesset committee and a Commissioner for Complaints for Senior Citizens.

positions.title: Local Senior Services
positions.summary: Transfer some responsibility and resources to local authorities and health funds; expand supportive-community models, transportation, local services and civilian-service support.

positions.title: Senior Participation
positions.summary: Encourage senior employment, entrepreneurship, volunteering, public participation and intergenerational connections.

positions.title: Women in Public Space
positions.summary: Combat exclusion of women from public spaces; increase penalties for destroying advertisements/images of women because of gender.

positions.title: Domestic Violence
positions.summary: Expand and permanently fund the national domestic-violence program.

positions.title: Sexual Assault Victim Services
positions.summary: Expand sexual-assault victim treatment and dedicated centers/hospital rooms.

positions.title: Equal Sports Resources
positions.summary: Ensure equal sports resources for women and men.

positions.title: Women's IDF Service
positions.summary: Base women’s IDF service on ability and suitability, not gender.

positions.title: Diabetes and Peripheral Hospitals
positions.summary: Restore the national diabetes program; complete two hospitals in the North and South.

positions.title: Medical Workforce and Hospitals
positions.summary: Increase doctors, nurses and medical-profession training positions, especially in the periphery; increase public-hospital beds and strengthen peripheral hospitals.

positions.title: Ambulatory and Preventive Healthcare
positions.summary: Expand ambulatory and preventive services.

positions.title: Health Basket
positions.summary: Regularly update the health basket to ensure access to needed treatments without public pressure campaigns.
